detail.abstract: We examine how the pandemic-driven rise in work from home (WFH) has affected labour market participation and employment in Italy. Leveraging a unique administrative dataset covering the population of remote workers, we find that WFH has had a positive effect on both activity and employment rates at the local labour market (LLM) level. To address endogeneity concerns, we instrument the observed increase in WFH with its potential, derived from LLM sectoral compositions. Controlling for several demographic and economic factors that could affect the distribution of WFH potential, we find no evidence of pre-trends. We also explore the mechanisms driving our results. The impact is stronger in response to the increase in WFH among women of child-rearing age and in areas with limited childcare services. We also find that the effect is more pronounced in the South and in less densely populated areas. These findings suggest that WFH can play a role in terms of labour market inclusion.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了新冠疫情驱动的远程工作增加如何影响意大利劳动力市场参与和就业。研究发现远程工作对地方劳动力市场的活动率和就业率有积极影响，尤其对育龄妇女和托儿服务有限地区影响更显著。
AI.research_question: 新冠疫情驱动的远程工作增加如何影响意大利劳动力市场参与和就业？
AI.motivation: 新冠疫情导致远程工作大规模增加，需要了解这种工作模式变化对劳动力市场参与和就业的影响，特别是在意大利这样的国家。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力市场参与理论、远程工作理论、地方劳动力市场理论、性别与家庭经济学理论。
AI.method: 使用覆盖所有远程工作者的独特行政数据集，采用工具变量法解决内生性问题，以地方劳动力市场部门构成推导的远程工作潜力作为工具变量，控制多种人口和经济因素。
AI.findings: 1. 远程工作对地方劳动力市场的活动率和就业率有积极影响；2. 对育龄妇女和托儿服务有限地区影响更显著；3. 在南部和人口密度较低地区效果更明显；4. 未发现预趋势证据。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为远程工作对劳动力市场参与的影响提供实证证据；2. 揭示远程工作促进劳动力市场包容性的机制；3. 拓展了工作安排灵活性对劳动力供给影响的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供远程工作促进就业的证据；2. 帮助设计支持育龄妇女参与劳动力市场的政策；3. 为地区发展不平衡问题提供解决方案参考；4. 为企业灵活工作安排提供决策依据。

title: Existence in Risk Sharing with Non-Convex Preferences under Convex Constraints
affiliations: Heriot-Watt University

detail.title: Existence in Risk Sharing with Non-Convex Preferences under Convex Constraints
detail.abstract: We study a social-planner risk-sharing problem on L p with finitely many agents and a convex feasible set generated by market clearing and economically natural constraints such as limited liability, retention bounds, and caps. Preferences V i are allowed to be non-concave and may fail weak upper semicontinuity. Our contribution is twofold. First, we establish a benchmark existence theorem: if the feasible set is weakly sequentially compact and the planner objective is sequentially weakly upper semicontinuous, then an optimizer exists. Second, we develop an alternative existence route that does not rely on weak upper semicontinuity. Exploiting convex feasibility, we apply a Mazur-type convexification to maximizing sequences, upgrading weak convergence to strong L p convergence. Under strong (L p) upper semicontinuity and a mild finite-mixture stability condition for preferences on bounded sets, we recover existence on capped insurance-type contract sets. We verify these conditions for distortion/rank-dependent utility and cumulative prospect theory specifications and give counterexamples showing that existence can fail when boundedness/uniform integrability or stability is dropped.

AI.tldr: 本文研究具有有限多参与者的社会规划者风险分担问题，在Lp空间上考虑由市场出清和有限责任、保留边界、上限等经济自然约束生成的凸可行集。偏好Vi可以是非凹的且可能缺乏弱上半连续性。主要贡献是：1) 建立基准存在性定理；2) 开发不依赖弱上半连续性的替代存在性路径。
AI.research_question: 在Lp空间中，当参与者偏好非凹且可能缺乏弱上半连续性时，社会规划者的风险分担问题是否存在最优解？
AI.motivation: 传统风险分担理论通常假设偏好是凹的且具有连续性，但现实中的决策者偏好往往是非凹的（如前景理论中的损失厌恶），且可能缺乏弱上半连续性。需要发展能够处理这些更一般偏好的存在性理论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 凸分析理论；2) 泛函分析中的弱拓扑和强拓扑；3) Mazur凸化技术；4) 扭曲/秩依赖效用理论；5) 累积前景理论
AI.method: 1) 建立基准存在性定理：当可行集弱序列紧且规划者目标函数弱序列上半连续时，最优解存在；2) 开发替代存在性路径：利用凸可行性，对最大化序列应用Mazur型凸化，将弱收敛升级为强Lp收敛
AI.findings: 1) 在弱序列紧可行集和弱序列上半连续目标函数条件下，最优解存在；2) 在强(Lp)上半连续性和有界集上偏好满足温和有限混合稳定性条件下，可在上限保险型合同集上恢复存在性；3) 验证了扭曲/秩依赖效用和累积前景理论满足这些条件；4) 提供了反例显示当有界性/一致可积性或稳定性条件被放弃时，存在性可能失效
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 建立了处理非凹偏好和缺乏弱上半连续性偏好的风险分担存在性理论；2) 发展了不依赖弱上半连续性的替代存在性证明方法；3) 将Mazur凸化技术应用于风险分担问题；4) 为扭曲效用和前景理论等行为经济学模型提供了存在性保证
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为实际风险分担合同设计提供了理论支持，特别是包含上限、有限责任等现实约束的情况；2) 允许使用更符合实际决策行为的非凹偏好模型；3) 为保险、金融风险分担等实际问题提供了更灵活的分析框架

reference: MIT Center for Transportation & Logistics Research Paper No. 2026/003
title: Across the Atlantic: Early Labor Market Responses Following the Introduction of AI in the United States and the European Union
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Center for Transportation & Logistics, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Center for Transportation & Logistics, Laboratory for Production Management and Processes, Ecole Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL), CH-1015 Lausanne, Switzerland  and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - School of Engineering

detail.title: Across the Atlantic: Early Labor Market Responses Following the Introduction of AI in the United States and the European Union

publicationDetails.detailsText: MIT Center for Transportation & Logistics Research Paper No. 2026/003
publicationDetails.journalName: MIT Center for Transportation & Logistics Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We examine early labor market adjustments in the period associated with generative AI (Artificial Intelligence) introduction by comparing employment dynamics in the U.S. (United States) and the E.U. (European Union). Using large-scale workforce data linked to task-based AI exposure measures, we estimate within-firm employment reallocation by seniority and occupation while absorbing firm-level shocks. Across both regions, early-career employment contracts after 2022, with systematically larger relative declines in higher-exposure groups. Once firm-level shocks are controlled for, the magnitude of the declines is similar across the U.S. and E.U. Moving beyond exposure-quintile aggregation to an occupation-level framework reveals substantial heterogeneity that aggregate analyses obscure. Within the same occupation, employment responses vary across seniority levels. Correlation analyses show that exposure-linked contraction in Europe is more closely associated with changes in entry-level classes, while in the United States it is concentrated in large, high-exposure occupational groups.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了生成式AI引入后美国和欧盟的早期劳动力市场调整，发现两个地区初级职业就业都在2022年后收缩，高AI暴露群体下降更明显。控制企业层面冲击后，两地区下降幅度相似。职业层面分析显示显著异质性，欧洲的收缩与入门级职位变化更相关，而美国则集中在大型高暴露职业群体。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI引入后，美国和欧盟的早期劳动力市场调整有何差异？具体而言，就业如何在不同资历和职业间重新分配？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI的快速发展对劳动力市场产生潜在影响，但不同地区（美国vs欧盟）的调整模式可能存在差异，需要实证研究来理解早期市场反应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于任务导向的AI暴露理论，分析AI技术对劳动力市场的异质性影响；考虑企业层面冲击的吸收；比较不同制度环境（美国灵活劳动力市场vs欧盟更严格监管）下的调整模式。
AI.method: 使用大规模劳动力数据，结合基于任务的AI暴露度量，估计企业内按资历和职业的就业重新分配，同时控制企业层面冲击。采用暴露五分位数聚合和职业层面框架分析。
AI.findings: 1. 两个地区初级职业就业都在2022年后收缩，高AI暴露群体下降更明显；2. 控制企业层面冲击后，下降幅度在美欧相似；3. 职业层面分析显示显著异质性；4. 欧洲的收缩与入门级职位变化更相关，美国则集中在大型高暴露职业群体。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了生成式AI早期劳动力市场影响的实证证据；2. 揭示了不同制度环境下AI影响的异质性模式；3. 发展了考虑企业层面冲击的AI暴露分析方法；4. 强调了职业层面分析的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供AI劳动力市场影响的早期预警；2. 帮助企业和教育机构调整人力资源策略；3. 为不同地区制定针对性的劳动力市场政策提供依据；4. 强调需要关注特定职业群体的转型需求。

reference: MIT Center for Transportation & Logistics Research Paper No. 2026/004
title: Measuring the Intensive Margin of Work: Task Shares and Concentration
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Center for Transportation & Logistics and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - School of Engineering

detail.title: Measuring the Intensive Margin of Work: Task Shares and Concentration

publicationDetails.detailsText: MIT Center for Transportation & Logistics Research Paper No. 2026/004
publicationDetails.journalName: MIT Center for Transportation & Logistics Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Are jobs diffuse bundles of activities, or are they concentrated on a small core? This paper develops a statistical framework to measure the intensive margin of work using task-frequency survey responses from O*NET. Using categorical occurrence data for 12,495 tasks in O*NET 29.0, we construct within-occupation estimators of task flows and task shares that sum to one. Under a within-occupation homogeneous task-duration assumption, these shares can be interpreted as time allocations across tasks. We propagate sampling uncertainty from the underlying survey responses to obtain fully specified estimators of task flows and task shares, and provide diagnostic evidence on the robustness of the resulting measures. The framework yields interpretable, budget-share-like task weights that aggregate transparently into standard economic outcomes, including exposure indices, and workforce or wage-bill decompositions. Empirically, we document a pronounced core-periphery structure of work: on average, the top three tasks account for about 31% of implied labor input across occupations. Linking task shares to U.S. microdata, we show that a small fraction of tasks accounts for a disproportionate share of both employment and wage bill. We then quantify how AI exposure aggregates depend on the accounting margin: tasks exposed to LLM-powered software account for about 52% of the wage bill but only 42% of employment. As external validation, we show that moments constructed from task-share weights yield economically interpretable wage gradients: occupational specialization predicts higher wages. Conditional on work content, this association attenuates with routine intensity. Standard intensive-margin proxies reproduce neither the specialization gradient nor its attenuation.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一个统计框架，使用O*NET任务频率调查数据测量工作的集约边际。研究发现工作呈现明显的核心-外围结构：平均而言，前三大任务占各职业隐含劳动投入的约31%。任务份额数据显示，少数任务占据了就业和工资总额的过大比例。AI暴露度测量显示，受LLM软件影响的任务占工资总额的52%但仅占就业的42%。职业专业化预测更高的工资，但这一关联随常规强度增加而减弱。
AI.research_question: 工作是分散的活动束还是集中在小的核心任务上？如何测量工作的集约边际（任务时间分配）？工作内容的核心-外围结构特征是什么？任务份额如何影响经济结果如工资和AI暴露度？
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏对工作内容集约边际的系统测量方法，无法准确量化任务在职业内的相对重要性。理解工作的核心-外围结构对于分析劳动力市场变化、技术影响（如AI）和工资决定机制至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于任务经济学理论，将工作视为任务束；采用预算份额类似的任务权重框架；在职业内同质任务持续时间假设下，任务份额可解释为时间分配；将任务份额与标准经济结果（暴露指数、劳动力分解、工资分解）透明聚合。
AI.method: 使用O*NET 29.0中12,495个任务的分类发生数据；构建职业内任务流量和任务份额估计量（总和为1）；传播抽样不确定性获得完全指定的估计量；将任务份额链接到美国微观数据；通过诊断证据验证测量稳健性。
AI.findings: 1. 工作呈现明显的核心-外围结构：平均前三大任务占隐含劳动投入的31%；2. 少数任务占据就业和工资总额的过大比例；3. AI暴露度测量：受LLM软件影响的任务占工资总额52%但仅占就业42%；4. 职业专业化预测更高工资，但这一关联随常规强度增加而减弱；5. 标准集约边际代理变量无法复制专业化梯度或其衰减。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 开发了测量工作集约边际的统计框架；2. 提供了可解释的、类似预算份额的任务权重；3. 建立了任务份额与标准经济结果的透明聚合方法；4. 揭示了工作的核心-外围结构理论意义；5. 为任务经济学提供了新的测量工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供工作内容的结构化测量；2. 帮助企业理解AI对劳动力市场的异质性影响；3. 为职业培训和技能发展提供数据支持；4. 为工资决定机制研究提供新视角；5. 为劳动力市场分析提供更精确的测量工具。

title: Irritability, Agency, and the Transmission of Dehumanizing Patterns under Chronic Stress
affiliations: Independent Researcher in Behavioral Science and Systems Psychology

detail.title: Irritability, Agency, and the Transmission of Dehumanizing Patterns under Chronic Stress

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. This research was conducted independently, without external funding, sponsorship, or institutional affiliation that could bias the results. All analyses and interpretations represent the author’s own scientific and professional conclusions.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The research involved non-interventional, naturalistic social observation without collection of personal data. Ethical approval was not required in accordance with international research standards for non-invasive studies.
declarations.funderStatement: This study was fully self-funded by the author. No external financial support or institutional sponsorship was received.

detail.abstract: This article develops a systemic model of irritability as a predictable regulatory response to prolonged constraint, sustained uncertainty, and restricted agency. Irritability is conceptualized not as a dispositional trait, cultural norm, or individual deficit, but as a socially transmissible pattern of affective and behavioral regulation that stabilizes under chronic stress. The paper advances four original contributions. First, it formalizes a rigorous distinction between affective dysregulation and ethical failure, extending Viktor E. Frankl's insights beyond extreme conditions into ordinary institutional, familial, and civic environments. Second, it conceptualizes irritability as a transmissible regulatory pattern embedded in social roles, interactional routines, and stress physiology, explaining its persistence after coercive conditions have formally ceased. Third, drawing on long-term empirical observation and contemporary neurobehavioral research, it identifies specific behavioral markers through which constrained agency manifests across age groups and contexts. Fourth, the article outlines agency-preserving mechanisms that interrupt transmission without denial, withdrawal, or moral disengagement. The analysis integrates logotherapy, moral philosophy, historiography, systems theory, and neuroscience within a nonattributive, mechanism-focused framework. Implications are offered for leadership, institutional design, family systems, and resilience-oriented reform.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个系统性模型，将易怒性概念化为对长期约束、持续不确定性和受限能动性的可预测调节反应，而非个人特质或文化规范。论文区分了情感失调与道德失败，将易怒性视为嵌入社会角色和互动常规的可传播调节模式，并识别了特定行为标记和能动性保护机制。
AI.research_question: 易怒性如何作为对长期约束、不确定性和能动性受限的系统性调节反应而产生和传播？如何区分情感失调与道德失败，并识别中断易怒性传播的机制？
AI.motivation: 传统上将易怒性视为个人特质、文化规范或个体缺陷，缺乏对系统性约束条件下易怒性作为调节反应的理解。需要建立更全面的框架来解释易怒性在社会系统中的产生、传播和持续。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合意义治疗（维克多·弗兰克尔）、道德哲学、历史编纂学、系统理论和神经科学，建立非归因性、机制聚焦的框架。强调社会角色、互动常规和应激生理学的相互作用。
AI.method: 基于长期实证观察和当代神经行为研究，识别跨年龄组和情境的行为标记。采用机制分析而非归因分析的方法论。
AI.findings: 1. 易怒性是慢性压力下稳定的情感行为调节模式；2. 在强制条件正式结束后仍持续存在；3. 通过特定行为标记在不同情境中表现；4. 存在能动性保护机制可中断传播。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 形式化区分情感失调与道德失败；2. 将易怒性概念化为可传播的调节模式；3. 识别约束能动性的行为标记；4. 提出非归因性、机制聚焦的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为领导力、制度设计、家庭系统和韧性导向改革提供实践启示。提供中断易怒性传播的具体机制，避免否认、退缩或道德脱离。

title: Toward a Procedural Benchmark for Regulatory Sandboxes: An Application of the Experiential Learning Model to Regulatory Governance
affiliations: VU University Amsterdam - Faculty of Social Sciences and Harvard University

detail.title: Toward a Procedural Benchmark for Regulatory Sandboxes: An Application of the Experiential Learning Model to Regulatory Governance
detail.abstract: Regulatory sandboxes are increasingly used as a governance tool and commonly characterized in terms of substantive outcomes such as greater innovativeness or deregulation that sandboxes are presumed to engender. The present article argues for evaluating regulatory sandboxes primarily in procedural terms rather than outcomes, which are contingent on policymaker motives and the concrete sandbox implementation. Through an innovative adaptation of the experiential learning model to the realm of regulation, the article advances a procedural standard against which one can critically assess regulatory sandboxes. The model serves to conceptualize the stages of a collaborative experiential learning process that occurs through sandboxes and complements the traditional policy cycle. This notion of learning furthermore provides the basis for formulating key requirements needed to make that kind of regulatory learning work. Not only does this learning demand suitable design features, but also a specific kind of craftsmanship and stakeholder commitment to evidence-based practices.

AI.tldr: 本文主张从程序而非结果角度评估监管沙盒，提出基于体验式学习模型的分析框架，强调监管学习过程需要合适的设计、专业能力和利益相关者承诺。
AI.research_question: 如何从程序角度而非结果角度评估监管沙盒的有效性？
AI.motivation: 当前对监管沙盒的评估主要关注实质性结果（如创新性、放松监管），但这些结果受政策制定者动机和具体实施方式影响，具有偶然性，需要更稳定的程序性评估标准。
AI.theoretical_framework: 体验式学习模型在监管领域的创新应用，将监管沙盒视为协作式体验学习过程，补充传统政策周期理论。
AI.method: 理论构建方法，通过创新性地将体验式学习模型应用于监管领域，提出程序性评估框架。
AI.findings: 监管沙盒应被视为协作式体验学习过程，包含具体阶段；有效的监管学习需要合适的设计特征、特定的专业能力和利益相关者对证据实践的共同承诺。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出从程序而非结果角度评估监管沙盒的新视角；2) 将体验式学习模型创新应用于监管领域；3) 构建监管学习的程序性评估标准；4) 补充传统政策周期理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供评估监管沙盒的程序性框架；2) 指导监管沙盒设计需要考虑学习过程特征；3) 强调专业能力和利益相关者承诺对监管学习的重要性；4) 促进证据基础的监管实践。

detail.title: Domicile vs. Protocol: Empirically Disentangling Regulatory Risk Premiums in the Post-GENIUS Act Era
detail.abstract: the GENIUS Act's prohibition of issuer-paid interest. We identify three distinct pricing mechanisms: protocol-driven dynamics, strategically administered rewards, and evolving regulatory risk premiums. During baseline conditions, protocol selection dominated yield determination, with spreads far exceeding regulatory domicile effects. However, an October 10, 2025, exogenous tariff shock created a natural experiment: DeFi yields responded elastically, spiking from 4.25% to 22.6% on Aave, while custodial rewards remained administratively fixed. By November 15, 2025, Coinbase executed a strategic pivot, aggressively promoting on-chain wallet rewards (4.70%) over custodial products (3.85%). This maneuver exploited a "distributor loophole," allowing Coinbase yields to exceed DeFi rates while maintaining legal distance from issuer prohibitions. Concurrently, the regulatory risk premium for offshore stablecoins expanded from an insignificant 0.05% to 0.47%, driven by intensified enforcement and security incidents. These findings reveal that stablecoin yields are shaped by sophisticated regulatory arbitrage and platform-specific incentives. The results offer critical implications for the pending CLARITY Act, Responsible Financial Innovation Act, and the future of issuer-centric digital asset regulation.

detail.abstract: The world we live in today is fascinating, we are at the cusp of the fourth and fifth industrial revolution. It took us almost three centuries to get here since the first industrial revolution, the good part is that we will not have to wait for an equal period to experience the subsequent industrial revolutions. The pace and intensity of change is unprecedented and gives one the feeling of being in a sci-fi movie. Vectors shaping the future of work are complex, nuanced and multi-dimensional requiring us to adopt varied strategies so as to thrive in the current order. It requires us to transcend into higher maturity levels of change navigation continuum - to become change architects for our personal selves. Being a change architect would amplify the vector qualities required to sense-make the future. It would help optimise the efforts and energy required to thrive in the future through materiality, intentionality and directionality. This paper takes inspiration from nature, our biggest teacher on how humans can become better change architects to thrive in the future.

detail.abstract: This study investigates how a firm's informal origins-starting operations without formal registration-shape its organisational capital, specifically, formal management practices in developing and emerging economies. Drawing on agency theory and organisational imprinting, we theorise that informal creation imposes informality costs through adverse selection and moral hazard, limiting access to high-quality human capital and leading to sub-optimal imprinted management practices that persist even after formalisation. Using an integrative framework of machine learning and regression analysis, we find that formally registered firms with informal origins exhibit weaker management practices and lower productivity than firms registered at inception. Mediation analysis confirms that management practices significantly mediate the productivity gap through constrained human capital acquisition. Counterfactual simulations suggest early formalisation could raise average productivity by 2.2%, especially for younger firms. Our findings highlight organisational capital as a key mechanism linking informality to performance, with important implications for theory, management, and policy.

AI.findings:

3. 揭示了非正式起源对企业长期发展的持久影响。

1. 为管理者提供了关于早期正式化重要性的证据。

3. 强调了改善管理实践和人力资本获取对提升企业绩效的重要性。

detail.abstract:
Stablecoins—digital tokens backed by fiat currency and high-quality liquid assets—represent an important step in the modernization of payment and settlement systems. When governed by clear prudential standards, they hold the potential to enhance payment efficiency, liquidity management, and transparency across the financial system. The GENIUS Act establishes an initial regulatory framework for stablecoin issuance in the United States by mandating full reserve backing, enforceable redemption rights, and standardized disclosures—features that aim to align stablecoin activity with long-standing financial stability and consumer protection objectives.

Despite concerns expressed in popular press or casual industry reports, empirical evidence and recent theoretical studies indicate that, under such a framework, stablecoins may complement rather than disrupt the traditional banking system. Deposit erosion or systemic risks depend critically on underlying economic frictions—particularly deposit-rate stickiness, search costs, and reserve composition—and available evidence suggests that these risks appear limited under the new regulatory landscape. To date, stablecoin adoption has not produced meaningful aggregate outflows from traditional bank deposits. Moreover, under realistic yield environments consistent with the GENIUS Act, competition from regulated stablecoin issuers may reinforce rather than weaken bank intermediation by encouraging more competitive deposit pricing and more efficient liquidity allocation, provided that regulatory capital frameworks ensure a level playing field between tokenized liabilities and traditional deposits.

Stablecoins also present potential operational and strategic opportunities for incumbent financial institutions. Banks may derive benefits from providing custody and reserve-management services for issuers, managing associated high-quality liquid assets, or developing tokenized liabilities within prudential constraints. Integrating these functions—either directly or through partnerships with stablecoin issuers—may allow institutions to adapt existing business models to a broader, more digital ecosystem while maintaining customer relationships and operational continuity.

Importantly, the GENIUS Act’s safeguards are poised to address the key vulnerabilities identified in the literature, including run and liquidity risk. Full one-to-one backing in high-quality liquid assets (cash, Treasury bills, and deposits at insured depositories), legally enforceable par-value redemption rights, and standardized public disclosure of reserves reduce uncertainty about issuers’ solvency and liquidity, thereby lowering the likelihood of run-like redemption pressures. As adoption grows and markets for stablecoins deepen, broader institutional participation and reputation effects may further support peg stability in normal market conditions. Stablecoins may also support financial stability more broadly: their demand for safe assets can deepen these markets, and under stress, regulated stablecoins may channel flows toward high-quality liquid assets, subject to the absorption capacity of Treasury markets. In addition, tokenized, on-chain settlement can improve operational resilience and reduce counterparty risk, particularly in cross-border transactions.

Looking ahead, collaboration between regulators, financial institutions, and technology providers will remain critical for ensuring that innovation proceeds within a safe and transparent framework. Naturally, residual risks remain, as no policy framework can eliminate them entirely. For example, reserve-only regimes remain exposed to extreme but low-probability shocks to safe-asset markets and to operational failures at custodial institutions. However, these vulnerabilities appear broadly comparable to those faced by other financial institutions and financial innovations in the past. Careful regulatory designs, not outright bans without a thorough understanding of the underlying economics, are needed.

Overall, with prudent oversight, issuer diversification, and consistent global standards, well-regulated stablecoins can serve as a durable, interoperable payment instrument integrated into the existing financial system, advancing its infrastructure, inclusion, and resilience in both theory and practice.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了在GENIUS法案监管框架下，稳定币如何与传统银行系统互补而非破坏，通过实证和理论研究表明，在充分准备金、可执行赎回权和标准化披露的监管下，稳定币能提升支付效率、流动性管理和透明度，同时为金融机构带来新的业务机会。
AI.research_question: 在GENIUS法案建立的监管框架下，稳定币如何影响传统银行系统和金融稳定？稳定币是破坏还是补充传统金融体系？
AI.motivation: 稳定币作为由法币和高质量流动资产支持的数字代币，代表了支付和结算系统现代化的重要一步。尽管大众媒体和行业报告表达了担忧，但需要实证和理论研究来评估在适当监管框架下稳定币对传统银行系统的实际影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于金融稳定理论、消费者保护理论、银行中介理论，以及存款利率粘性、搜索成本、准备金构成等经济摩擦理论。GENIUS法案建立的监管框架包括充分准备金要求、可执行赎回权和标准化披露。
AI.method: 结合实证证据分析和理论模型研究。分析稳定币采用的实际数据，评估其对银行存款流出的影响；基于GENIUS法案的监管要求，构建理论框架分析稳定币与银行系统的互动关系。
AI.findings: 1. 稳定币采用尚未导致传统银行存款的显著流出；2. 在GENIUS法案的收益率环境下，受监管的稳定币发行者可能通过鼓励更具竞争力的存款定价和更有效的流动性分配来加强而非削弱银行中介；3. 稳定币为现有金融机构提供了托管、准备金管理和代币化负债等业务机会；4. GENIUS法案的保障措施有效解决了挤兑和流动性风险等关键脆弱性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了在监管框架下稳定币与传统银行系统互补性的理论模型；2. 阐明了存款利率粘性、搜索成本和准备金构成等经济摩擦在决定稳定币影响中的关键作用；3. 提出了稳定币通过深化安全资产市场和支持金融稳定的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了基于证据的监管设计建议；2. 为金融机构识别了稳定币相关的业务机会（托管、准备金管理、代币化负债）；3. 展示了如何通过监管框架（充分准备金、可执行赎回权、标准化披露）降低稳定币风险；4. 强调了监管机构、金融机构和技术提供商之间合作的重要性。

title: Gauging Hourly Economic Activity in Your Neighborhood
affiliations: University of California San Diego, UCSD  and

detail.title: Gauging Hourly Economic Activity in Your Neighborhood
detail.abstract: Imagine gauging hourly economic activity at the local (zip-code) level. We argue that this is now feasible and propose a new granular economic modeling approach (GEM) for measuring, modeling, and predicting economic activity at high levels of granularity. Our approach uses bridging equations and aggregation constraints to link highly granular spatio-temporal data on variables such as foot traffic, traffic flows, electricity usage and credit card spending with aggregate data on payrolls and income. We extract a common dynamic factor that summarizes local, hourly economic activity and is consistent with observable measures observed at far coarser levels of granularity such as city-wide payroll data and GDP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的细粒度经济建模方法（GEM），能够以邮政编码级别、每小时的时间分辨率测量、建模和预测经济活动。该方法通过桥接方程和聚合约束，将细粒度的时空数据（如人流、交通流量、用电量和信用卡消费）与宏观数据（如工资单和收入）联系起来，提取出一个共同动态因子来总结本地每小时的经济活动。
AI.research_question: 如何以高粒度（邮政编码级别、每小时）测量、建模和预测经济活动？
AI.motivation: 传统经济数据通常具有较低的时空粒度（如城市级别的月度数据），无法捕捉本地、实时的经济活动变化。随着细粒度数据（如人流、交通流量、用电量、信用卡消费等）的可用性增加，需要开发新的方法来利用这些数据测量经济活动。
AI.theoretical_framework: 细粒度经济建模（GEM）框架，基于桥接方程和聚合约束理论，将细粒度数据与宏观经济数据联系起来，提取共同动态因子。
AI.method: 使用桥接方程和聚合约束，将细粒度时空数据（人流、交通流量、用电量、信用卡消费）与宏观数据（工资单、收入）进行整合，提取共同动态因子来总结本地每小时经济活动。
AI.findings: 能够提取出一个共同动态因子，该因子能够总结本地每小时的经济活动，并且与更粗粒度（如城市级别工资数据、GDP）的可观测指标保持一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了细粒度经济建模（GEM）的理论框架，发展了将细粒度数据与宏观数据整合的方法论，扩展了经济测量的时空分辨率。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、企业和研究人员提供了实时、本地化的经济活动测量工具，能够支持更精准的政策评估、商业决策和区域经济分析。

title: The Impact of Overtourism in Cultural Resilience in Badung, Bali: Commercialization of Culture
affiliations: Universitas Pendidikan Nasional, Universitas Gadjah Mada (UGM) and University of Gadjah Mada

detail.title: The Impact of Overtourism in Cultural Resilience in Badung, Bali: Commercialization of Culture
detail.abstract: This research examines how overtourism affects the cultural resilience of local communities, especially in relation to social practices, traditional values, and cultural identity in Badung, Bali. This study used a qualitative method involving interviews with 25 people, field observations, literature reviews, and thematic coding for data analysis. The research findings indicate that excessive tourism is impacting cultural resilience in Badung, Bali, leading to its commercialization. This excessive commercialization involves shifts in social values, dynamic cultural characteristics, the commitment of local governments, and the role of traditional villages. The study concludes that while excessive tourism poses substantial problems, the cultural resilience of the Badung community remains flexible and adaptive, shaped by ongoing efforts to balance economic demands with the preservation of cultural authenticity.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨巴厘岛巴东地区过度旅游对当地文化韧性的影响，发现过度商业化改变了社会价值观和文化特征，但当地社区通过灵活适应保持了文化韧性。
AI.research_question: 过度旅游如何影响巴厘岛巴东地区当地社区的文化韧性，特别是在社会习俗、传统价值观和文化认同方面？
AI.motivation: 随着巴厘岛旅游业的快速发展，过度旅游现象日益严重，可能对当地社区的文化韧性产生深远影响，需要研究这种影响的具体机制和表现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文化韧性理论，关注社区在面对外部压力（如过度旅游）时保持、适应和传承文化的能力。
AI.method: 定性研究方法，包括对25人的访谈、实地观察、文献回顾和主题编码进行数据分析。
AI.findings: 过度旅游正在影响巴东地区的文化韧性，导致文化商业化。这种过度商业化涉及社会价值观的转变、文化特征的动态变化、地方政府的承诺以及传统村庄的角色。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对文化韧性在旅游压力下表现机制的理解，揭示了文化商业化作为文化韧性变化的具体路径，扩展了文化韧性理论在旅游研究中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴东地区和其他旅游目的地提供了管理过度旅游对文化影响的参考，强调了平衡经济发展与文化保护的重要性，为地方政府和传统村庄制定文化保护策略提供了依据。

title: Legitimate Extraction: Sophisticated Laundering Hides in Plain Sight Hedging as the Fourth Money Laundering Stage

detail.title: Legitimate Extraction: Sophisticated Laundering Hides in Plain Sight Hedging as the Fourth Money Laundering Stage

keywords: petrostate corruption JEL Codes: G28 (Government Policy and Regulation)
K42 (Illegal Behavior and Enforcement of Law)

detail.abstract:
The architecture of anti-money laundering regulation reveals something curious when examined closely: the frameworks designed to combat illicit finance have, over decades, become quite effective at detecting the primitive methods—cash structuring, money mules, the deposit patterns that first emerged during Prohibition—while remaining largely blind to the sophisticated mechanisms through which the most consequential wealth extraction actually occurs. This paper examines that asymmetry through five cases spanning different decades and regulatory environments (BCCI, the London Laundromat, Danske Bank, FTX, and Binance), and finds that what appears as regulatory gap is better understood as regulatory architecture—a structure that, by design or by accident, directs attention toward certain kinds of transactions while leaving others invisible.

The traditional three-stage model of money laundering—placement, layering, integration—describes cash-based crime elegantly, but it rests on assumptions that fail when we turn from drug traffickers to kleptocratic elites: that illicit funds must be smuggled into the financial system, that their origins carry markers of suspicion, that the objective is returning dirty money to the legitimate economy for consumption. What this paper proposes is the recognition of a fourth stage, hedging, in which extracted wealth is converted into precisely the activities that regulatory frameworks not only permit but encourage—currency hedges, commodity futures, the ordinary prudence of protecting assets against volatility. The same transactions that constitute responsible risk management can simultaneously serve as the final step in kleptocratic extraction, and this dual nature is what makes the hedging stage both distinctive and, under current frameworks, essentially undetectable.

Drawing on evidence from the Panama Papers, the Pandora Papers, and court records documenting sovereign hedging programs, the analysis traces how these mechanisms operate in practice: the Kazakhstan devaluations where elites positioned offshore while citizens absorbed purchasing power collapse, the London property market where opacity serves insurance functions for the politically exposed, the derivative contracts where beneficial ownership disappears into offshore structures. The Vienna Convention (1988) and Palermo Convention (2000) define money laundering broadly enough to reach these mechanisms—the conversion of property derived from offense, undertaken to evade legal consequences—but current frameworks do not operationalize this reach.

What follows is a set of proposals: transparency requirements for sovereign hedging programs, beneficial ownership verification for derivative counterparties, hedging transaction due diligence calibrated to actual rather than assumed risk profiles. None of this would eliminate the fourth stage, but it might begin to address the gap between what AML frameworks claim to combat and what they actually see.

title: Adverse Impact Indicators: How Sustainable are Sustainable Funds?
affiliations: Justus-Liebig-University Giessen,  and University of Giessen - Department of Financial Services

detail.title: Adverse Impact Indicators: How Sustainable are Sustainable Funds?
detail.abstract: This paper evaluates whether sustainable funds effectively minimize adverse impact, measured using the Principal Adverse Impact (PAI) indicators. We confirm that both sustainable fund names and SFDR labels are associated with lower adverse impact. However, we still find impact heterogeneity across individual PAI indicators and only a weak distinction in impact levels between Article 8 and Article 9 funds. Notably, our analysis reveals that voluntary PAI indicators often possess greater predictive power with regard to impact than mandatory ones. We conclude that broad sustainability classifications such as fund names or SFDR labels alone are insufficient for impactfocused investors. Moreover, regulators should revise the designation of mandatory versus voluntary PAI indicators to better reflect the actual drivers of sustainability.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估可持续基金是否有效减少负面影响（使用PAI指标衡量），发现基金名称和SFDR标签与较低负面影响相关，但存在指标异质性，且第8条与第9条基金差异微弱。自愿性PAI指标比强制性指标更具预测力，表明现有分类对影响力投资者不足，需修订监管指标设计。
AI.research_question: 可持续基金是否有效减少负面影响？基金名称、SFDR标签等分类方式能否准确反映基金的实际环境影响？自愿性与强制性PAI指标在预测影响力方面有何差异？
AI.motivation: 随着可持续投资增长，投资者需要可靠工具评估基金的实际环境影响。现有分类（如基金名称、SFDR标签）可能无法准确反映基金的真实表现，需要实证检验这些分类与具体负面影响指标的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于可持续金融理论、影响力投资理论、信息披露理论，以及欧盟SFDR监管框架下的PAI指标体系，探讨分类信号与实际表现之间的关系。
AI.method: 实证研究，使用PAI指标作为负面影响衡量标准，分析可持续基金名称、SFDR标签（第8条和第9条）与PAI指标的关系，比较自愿性和强制性PAI指标的预测能力。
AI.findings: 1. 可持续基金名称和SFDR标签与较低负面影响相关；2. 不同PAI指标存在异质性；3. 第8条与第9条基金在影响水平上差异微弱；4. 自愿性PAI指标比强制性指标更具预测力。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 深化对可持续金融分类有效性的理解；2. 揭示分类信号与实际环境影响之间的差距；3. 为信息披露理论提供实证证据，特别是自愿与强制披露的效果差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提醒影响力投资者不能仅依赖基金名称或SFDR标签；2. 建议监管机构修订PAI指标设计，使强制性指标更能反映实际可持续性驱动因素；3. 为基金评估提供更精细的分析框架。

title: Heaven or Earth? The Evolving Role of Global Shocks for Domestic Monetary Policy
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management, World Bank and World Bank

detail.title: Heaven or Earth? The Evolving Role of Global Shocks for Domestic Monetary Policy
detail.abstract: Business cycles are increasingly driven by global shocks, rather than the domestic demand shocks prominent in earlier decades, posing challenges for central banks seeking to meet domestic mandates and communicate their policy decisions. This paper analyzes the evolving influence and characteristics of global and domestic shocks in advanced economies from 1970-2024 using a new FAVAR model that decomposes movements in interest rates, inflation, and output growth into four global shocks (demand, supply, oil, and monetary policy) and three domestic shocks (demand, supply, and monetary policy). We find that the role of global shocks has increased sharply over time and that their characteristics differ from those of domestic shocks across multiple dimensions. Compared to domestic shocks, global shocks have a larger supply component, higher variance, more persistent effects on inflation, and are more asymmetric (contributing more to tightening than to easing phases of monetary policy). As global supply shocks have become more prominent, central banks have also been less willing to "look through" their effects on inflation than for comparable domestic shocks. The distinct characteristics and rising influence of global shocks-particularly global supply shocks-have significant implications for modeling monetary policy and designing central bank frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，全球冲击（特别是全球供给冲击）对发达经济体商业周期的影响日益增强，且与国内冲击在多方面存在显著差异，这对央行货币政策建模和框架设计有重要启示。
AI.research_question: 全球冲击与国内冲击对发达经济体商业周期的影响如何演变？两者在特征上有何差异？这些变化对央行货币政策有何启示？
AI.motivation: 商业周期越来越多地由全球冲击而非国内需求冲击驱动，这给央行实现国内政策目标和沟通决策带来了挑战，需要深入理解全球冲击的特征和影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于FAVAR模型框架，将利率、通胀和产出增长的变动分解为四类全球冲击（需求、供给、石油、货币政策）和三类国内冲击（需求、供给、货币政策）。
AI.method: 使用新的FAVAR模型分析1970-2024年发达经济体的数据，量化全球和国内冲击的影响演变和特征差异。
AI.findings: 1. 全球冲击的作用随时间显著增强；2. 全球冲击比国内冲击具有更大的供给成分、更高的方差、对通胀更持久的影响；3. 全球冲击更具不对称性（对货币政策紧缩阶段的贡献大于宽松阶段）；4. 随着全球供给冲击日益突出，央行更不愿意"忽视"其对通胀的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了全球冲击与国内冲击在多个维度上的系统性差异，为理解全球化背景下商业周期驱动因素的变化提供了理论框架，对货币政策建模有重要启示。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行设计和调整政策框架提供实证依据，帮助央行更好地应对全球冲击带来的挑战，改进政策沟通和决策制定。

title: A Temporal Concentration Index for Credit Portfolios with Continuous-Time Markov Default Dynamics
affiliations: University College London

detail.title: A Temporal Concentration Index for Credit Portfolios with Continuous-Time Markov Default Dynamics
detail.abstract:
Concentration risk measurement in credit portfolios has traditionally relied on static indices such as the Herfindahl-Hirschman Index, which ignore the temporal dynamics of default clustering. We introduce the Temporal Concentration Index (TCI), a dynamic measure that integrates continuous-time Markov chain absorption dynamics with severity-weighted loss flows.

The TCI admits a conditional expectation representation: it equals the expected loss-flow concentration at the moment of default, given default within a specified horizon.

We establish sharp bounds, prove five axiomatic properties (normalization, symmetry, monotonicity, continuity, convergence), and derive a decomposition separating flow-timing concentration from severity-induced concentration. Closed-form horizon sensitivity formulas yield an interpretable factorization into conditional default intensity and concentration gap components, while a second-order ODE characterization enables efficient computation.

We derive the Hessian matrix with respect to loss severity parameters, providing convexity criteria and a Taylor expansion framework for rapid stress testing. Extending to multi-obligor portfolios with correlated defaults, we establish granularity limits showing O(N^-1) convergence to a systematic concentration measure, and develop Euler-based capital allocation decomposing portfolio TCI into obligor-level risk contributions.

Two numerical case studies demonstrate practical applicability: the first yields TCI values ranging from 0.89 (6-month horizon) to 0.60 (10-year horizon), exceeding the static HHI by up to 54%, while the second exhibits a critical horizon at t*h = 2.65 years where concentration transitions from decreasing to increasing—illustrating the regime classification framework developed herein.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了时间集中度指数（TCI），这是一种动态信用风险集中度度量方法，结合了连续时间马尔可夫链吸收动态和严重性加权损失流，相比传统静态指标能更好地捕捉违约聚类的时间动态。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个动态的信用投资组合集中度风险度量方法，能够捕捉违约聚类的时间动态，同时保持理论严谨性和计算可行性？
AI.motivation: 传统信用投资组合集中度风险测量（如赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数）是静态的，忽略了违约聚类的时间动态，这在风险管理中是一个重要缺陷。
AI.theoretical_framework: 连续时间马尔可夫链吸收动态、条件期望理论、公理化风险度量框架、欧拉分配理论
AI.method: 理论推导与数学建模：1）定义TCI为给定违约时间内的期望损失流集中度；2）建立公理性质；3）推导闭式敏感性公式；4）二阶ODE表征；5）扩展到多债务人投资组合；6）数值案例研究
AI.findings: 1）TCI值在6个月到10年期间从0.89降至0.60，比静态HHI高出54%；2）存在临界时间点（2.65年）集中度从递减转为递增；3）建立了可分解的集中度度量框架
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了首个动态信用集中度度量TCI；2）建立了完整的公理化框架；3）推导了闭式敏感性公式和ODE表征；4）发展了多债务人扩展和欧拉分配方法
AI.practical_contributions: 1）提供了更准确的集中度风险测量工具；2）支持快速压力测试；3）实现了债务人级别的风险贡献分解；4）帮助识别集中度变化的临界时间点

reference: Talbot, C. (2018). Competition law in times of crisis : Case studies of the airline sector and the Irish beef industry. Cambridge Scholars Publishing.
title: Competition Law in Times of Crisis Case Studies of the European Passenger Airline Sector and the Irish Beef Industry
affiliations: European University Institute, Department of Law (LAW), Alumni

detail.title: Competition Law in Times of Crisis Case Studies of the European Passenger Airline Sector and the Irish Beef Industry

publicationDetails.detailsText: Talbot, C. (2018). Competition law in times of crisis : Case studies of the airline sector and the Irish beef industry. Cambridge Scholars Publishing.

detail.abstract:
This book examines the role and utility of competition law within the EU’s legislative and regulatory dialogue, using its response to crisis conditions as a test of its aims and abilities. As such, its main conclusion is that competition policy acts as a forum for debate as to the direction of the European integration project, while competition law can serve as a tool for aiding in the implementation of broader policy objectives. The analysis here explores the role of the general economic context in the application of competition law, the existence of identifiable baselines applicable in crisis conditions, the ability and role of national competition authorities in applying competition law, and the ways in which the European Commission’s overarching policy goals can influence the application of competition law.

The decision to take an empirical approach to this research project stems from a conviction that an investigation into the real world situations faced by firms and consumers should underpin the evaluation of the applicable legal rules. Over the past number of years, the Commission has exerted more and more influence over the development of the regional and global airline industry, and this book identifies the emergence of an apparent overarching aim on the part of the Commission to create a market with a handful of ultra-competitive airlines with international reach serviced by an array of smaller feeder airlines on a regional basis. The study of Irish beef processing, on the other hand, identifies a high level of government involvement in providing the strategic thinking behind a crisis cartel scheme, and then demonstrates how the economic context exerted considerably more pressure on the government and the national court than on the competition authorities involved.

AI.tldr: 本书通过实证方法研究欧盟竞争法在危机条件下的应用，发现竞争政策是欧洲一体化项目方向的辩论平台，竞争法则可作为实现更广泛政策目标的工具。研究以航空业和牛肉加工业为例，分析了经济背景、危机基准、国家竞争机构角色及欧盟委员会政策目标对竞争法实施的影响。
AI.research_question: 欧盟竞争法在危机条件下如何发挥作用？竞争政策在欧洲一体化进程中扮演什么角色？经济背景和欧盟委员会的政策目标如何影响竞争法的实施？
AI.motivation: 研究欧盟竞争法在立法和监管对话中的角色和效用，特别是通过其在危机条件下的反应来检验其目标和能力。关注竞争法如何适应不断变化的经济环境和政策需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于欧盟竞争法理论框架，探讨竞争政策作为欧洲一体化辩论平台的理论基础，以及竞争法作为政策实施工具的理论依据。涉及危机条件下的法律适用基准理论。
AI.method: 采用实证研究方法，通过分析航空业和牛肉加工业两个具体案例来检验理论假设。研究关注企业在现实世界中面临的实际情境，以及法律规则在这些情境中的应用。
AI.findings: 1. 竞争政策是欧洲一体化项目方向的辩论平台；2. 竞争法可作为实现更广泛政策目标的工具；3. 欧盟委员会在航空业发展中发挥越来越大的影响力，目标是创建少数具有国际竞争力的超大型航空公司；4. 在爱尔兰牛肉加工业中，政府在危机卡特尔方案中提供战略思维，经济背景对政府和法院的压力大于对竞争机构的压力。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 发展了竞争法在危机条件下应用的理论框架；2. 提出了竞争政策作为欧洲一体化辩论平台的理论视角；3. 丰富了竞争法作为政策实施工具的理论理解；4. 为经济背景对法律实施影响提供了新的理论见解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为欧盟竞争法在危机条件下的实际应用提供指导；2. 帮助政策制定者理解竞争法如何支持更广泛的政策目标；3. 为国家竞争机构在危机条件下的执法提供参考；4. 为企业理解竞争法在特定经济环境下的适用提供实践指导。

title: Paternalism After Behavioral Economics
affiliations: Harvard Law School

detail.title: Paternalism After Behavioral Economics
detail.abstract: Is paternalism legitimate? Might it increase welfare? When would it compromise autonomy in some impermissible way? The outpouring of empirical work on cognitive biases, and on departures from perfect rationality, has led to a wholesale rethinking of paternalism and its limits. Over the last decades, three camps have emerged: (1) coercive paternalists, who urge that behavioral findings undermine John Stuart Mill's Harm Principle and greatly strengthen arguments for paternalistic mandates and bans; (2) libertarian paternalists, who urge that behavioral findings justify a host of paternalistic but freedom-preserving interventions or "nudges," such as warnings, reminders, labels, and automatic enrollment; and (3) antipaternalists, who urge that behavioral findings justify only, or at most, efforts to strengthen or "boost" people's competences, or their capacities to make good choices. On welfare grounds, it is possible to identify the assumptions under which one or another approach would be best. Libertarian paternalism often has significant advantages over coercive paternalism, at least in circumstances in which choosers are heterogeneous. But when all or most choosers err, the welfarist argument for coercive paternalism is strengthened. And when choosers are not only heterogeneous but also adequately informed and free from behavioral biases, antipaternalism makes a great deal of sense.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了行为经济学发现如何重塑对家长主义的理解，分析了强制家长主义、自由家长主义和反家长主义三种立场的理论基础，并基于福利标准评估了不同情境下各种家长主义干预的合理性。
AI.research_question: 在认知偏差和行为经济学发现的背景下，家长主义是否正当？何时能提高福利？何时会以不可接受的方式损害自主性？
AI.motivation: 关于认知偏差和非完美理性的实证研究大量涌现，促使学界重新思考家长主义及其限制，形成了三种不同立场的学术阵营。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于约翰·斯图尔特·密尔的伤害原则、行为经济学理论、福利经济学框架，以及自主性、认知偏差、选择能力等概念。
AI.method: 概念分析与理论论证，基于福利标准评估不同家长主义干预的合理性，考虑选择者异质性、信息充分性和行为偏差程度等情境因素。
AI.findings: 1. 自由家长主义在异质性选择者情境下通常优于强制家长主义；2. 当所有或大多数选择者犯错时，强制家长主义的福利论证增强；3. 当选择者异质且信息充分、无行为偏差时，反家长主义更有意义。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了行为经济学背景下家长主义理论的三种主要立场，建立了基于福利标准的评估框架，明确了不同情境下各种家长主义干预的适用条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了指导：在异质群体中优先考虑"助推"等自由家长主义干预；在普遍错误情境下可考虑强制措施；在理性充分情境下应避免家长主义干预。

title: Belonging, Loss, and Reinvention: A Mixed-Methods Study of Indian Trailing Spouses in Thailand
affiliations: and Suresh Gyan Vihar University Jaipur

detail.title: Belonging, Loss, and Reinvention: A Mixed-Methods Study of Indian Trailing Spouses in Thailand

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that there is no conflict of interest with respect to the research, authorship, and/or publication of this article. The research was conducted independently and was not influenced by any commercial, institutional, or organisational interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study was conducted in accordance with ethical standards for social science research. Participation was voluntary and based on informed consent. No personally identifiable information was collected, and all data were anonymised and securely stored in compliance with the Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562 (2019) of Thailand (PDPA). The research involved minimal risk and anonymous participation.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this study.

detail.abstract: This study examines the lived experiences of Indian trailing spouses in Thailand using a mixed-methods design that integrates quantitative survey data with qualitative open-ended responses. While Indian mobility to Thailand has expanded through corporate and entrepreneurial pathways, the experiences of accompanying spouses—predominantly women—remain underexplored within South Asian diaspora scholarship, particularly in non-Western host contexts. Drawing on a structured questionnaire complemented with three open-ended questions, administered to Indian trailing spouses residing primarily in Bangkok, the paper investigates three interrelated processes: identity loss, negotiated belonging, and personal reinvention. Quantitative findings indicate low overall identity disruption alongside moderate professional underutilisation, limited early autonomy, and gradual adaptation and resilience over time. Qualitative narratives contextualise these patterns, illustrating how gendered expectations, diasporic networks, and cultural navigation shape everyday life. By combining breadth and depth, this study contributes to debates on gendered migration, transnational family mobility, and identity formation within South Asian diasporas in Southeast Asia.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用混合方法设计，结合定量调查数据和定性开放式回答，探讨了印度随迁配偶在泰国的生活经历。研究发现这些配偶（主要为女性）面临身份失落、协商归属和个人重塑的过程，整体身份中断程度较低，但存在职业利用不足和早期自主权有限的问题，随时间推移逐渐适应并展现韧性。
AI.research_question: 印度随迁配偶在泰国经历的身份失落、协商归属和个人重塑过程是怎样的？这些过程如何受到性别期望、离散网络和文化适应的影响？
AI.motivation: 随着印度人通过企业和创业途径向泰国流动增加，随迁配偶（主要是女性）的经历在南亚离散研究中尚未得到充分探讨，特别是在非西方东道国背景下。现有研究对这些配偶在东南亚环境中的生活经历了解有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 性别化移民理论、跨国家庭流动理论、离散身份形成理论、文化适应理论
AI.method: 混合方法设计：结合定量问卷调查（结构化问卷）和定性数据收集（三个开放式问题），主要针对居住在曼谷的印度随迁配偶进行调查。
AI.findings: 1. 定量结果显示整体身份中断程度较低，但存在中等程度的职业利用不足和早期自主权有限的问题；2. 随时间推移逐渐适应并展现韧性；3. 定性叙述表明性别期望、离散网络和文化适应塑造了日常生活；4. 揭示了身份失落、协商归属和个人重塑三个相互关联的过程。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 丰富了性别化移民和跨国家庭流动的理论讨论；2. 扩展了南亚离散身份形成研究，特别是在非西方东道国背景下；3. 提供了关于随迁配偶在东南亚环境中适应过程的理论见解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为跨国公司和组织支持随迁配偶提供实践指导；2. 为移民政策制定者提供关于家庭流动支持的参考；3. 帮助随迁配偶更好地应对身份转变和适应挑战；4. 为社区支持网络建设提供依据。

title: Coercive Capacity, Social Dissent, Repression or Redistribution? Evidence from Authoritarian Mexico
affiliations: ITAM, Harvard University, Georgetown University and El Colegio de Mexico

detail.title: Coercive Capacity, Social Dissent, Repression or Redistribution? Evidence from Authoritarian Mexico
detail.abstract: Why do authoritarian regimes exhibit subnational variation in their use of repression versus redistribution to manage local dissent? We develop a model in which an autocrat's localized response to dissent depends on incomplete information about the geography of people's discontent and the government's coercive capacity, a feature that authoritarian governments often inherit from the past. The model predicts that when dissent rises, rulers are more likely to rely on repression rather on redistribution in areas with strong inherited coercive capacity. We then test these predictions using novel data from twentieth-century Mexico under PRI rule. Our empirical strategy exploits a sharp increase in overall dissent in the mid-1960s and three sources of subnational variation: (1) a large-scale land reform that redistributed over half of all agricultural land between 1910 and 1992; (2) the localized presence of regime-aligned rural militias with revolutionary origins; and (3) newly digitized archival records documenting individual instances of repression over time. Difference-in-Differences and Instrumental Variable estimates indicate that after the sudden increase in dissent, municipalities with a stronger militia presence experienced more repression events and less land redistribution than areas with weaker or no militia presence. Our findings demonstrate how historical variation in inherited coercive capacity and informational frictions can shape the subnational logic of authoritarian control.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨威权政权为何在地方层面采用镇压与再分配的不同策略来应对异议。研究发现，当异议增加时，统治者更可能在历史遗留强制能力强的地区依赖镇压而非再分配，墨西哥PRI统治时期的实证研究支持了这一理论。
AI.research_question: 为什么威权政权在管理地方异议时，会在次国家层面表现出镇压与再分配策略的差异？
AI.motivation: 理解威权政权如何在不同地区选择不同的控制策略，特别是镇压与再分配的权衡，对于理解威权统治的运作机制和地方政治动态具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于不完全信息理论，政府不了解民众不满的地理分布，同时继承了历史上的强制能力。这些因素共同决定了地方层面的控制策略选择。
AI.method: 理论模型结合实证检验。实证部分使用墨西哥PRI统治时期的新数据，包括土地改革、农村民兵分布和镇压事件档案。采用双重差分法和工具变量法进行分析。
AI.findings: 在1960年代中期异议激增后，民兵力量较强的市镇经历了更多镇压事件和更少的土地再分配。历史遗留的强制能力差异显著影响了威权控制的地方逻辑。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个解释威权政权地方控制策略差异的理论框架，强调不完全信息和历史遗留强制能力的作用，丰富了威权主义研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解威权政权的地方治理策略提供了实证依据，有助于预测不同地区可能面临的控制方式，对政策制定者和人权组织有参考价值。

title: Power-Boosted Granger-Causal Discovery for Large Heterogeneous Panel Data
affiliations: University of Notre Dame and University of Notre Dame

detail.title: Power-Boosted Granger-Causal Discovery for Large Heterogeneous Panel Data
detail.abstract: This paper proposes a power-enhanced panel Granger causality test (PE-PGCT) for assessing the Granger non-causality in heterogeneous and potentially high-dimensional panel data. Building on any existing panel Granger non-causality test, we show, both theoretically and empirically, that the proposed PE-PGCT boosts its power substantially. The power gains are particularly significant in situations of high-dimensional panels when the cross-sectional dimension exceeds the time dimension, as well as under sparse alternatives when the signals are sparsely distributed across panel units. We establish rigorous theoretical guarantees on the asymptotic behavior of the proposed power enhancement component, demonstrating attractive power enhancement properties that it induces negligible size distortion under the null hypothesis while delivering significant power gain under the alternatives. The empirical performances are illustrated via extensive simulation studies, as well as a real-world application.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种功率增强的面板格兰杰因果检验（PE-PGCT），用于评估异质性和潜在高维面板数据中的格兰杰非因果关系。该方法基于现有面板格兰杰非因果检验，通过理论分析和实证研究表明，PE-PGCT能显著提升检验功效，特别是在高维面板（截面维度超过时间维度）和稀疏替代假设（信号稀疏分布在面板单元中）的情况下。
AI.research_question: 如何有效评估异质性和高维面板数据中的格兰杰非因果关系，特别是在截面维度超过时间维度以及信号稀疏分布的情况下？
AI.motivation: 现有面板格兰杰因果检验在异质性和高维面板数据中可能存在功效不足的问题，特别是在截面维度超过时间维度以及信号稀疏分布的情况下，需要开发更有效的检验方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于面板格兰杰因果检验理论，结合高维统计和稀疏信号检测理论，构建功率增强的面板格兰杰因果检验框架。
AI.method: 提出功率增强的面板格兰杰因果检验（PE-PGCT），该方法基于现有面板格兰杰非因果检验，通过理论分析和实证模拟验证其性能，包括广泛的模拟研究和实际应用案例。
AI.findings: PE-PGCT能显著提升检验功效，特别是在高维面板（截面维度超过时间维度）和稀疏替代假设的情况下；功率增强分量在零假设下引起的尺寸扭曲可忽略，而在替代假设下能提供显著的功效增益。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了功率增强分量的严格理论保证，证明了其渐近行为，展示了在零假设下尺寸扭曲可忽略而在替代假设下功效显著增强的优良性质。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实证研究人员提供了更有效的面板格兰杰因果检验工具，特别适用于高维面板数据和稀疏信号场景，通过模拟研究和实际应用验证了方法的实用性。

title: Self-exciting Bank Shocks
affiliations: Oklahoma State University - Stillwater - Spears School of Business

detail.title: Self-exciting Bank Shocks
detail.abstract: Left tail returns of bank stocks display clustering characteristics.  Jump arrivals are modeled as Hawkes processes to capture these self-exciting properties.  Following an initial shock, the median bank’s conditional jump intensity increases to 8.3% and the median time to return to baseline levels is 21 days.  While passing TARP has had an immediate effect of reducing the conditional jump intensity of banks and banks' left tail risk sensitivities to aggregate left tail risk, passing the EGRRCPA has had no significant effect.  Systematic jumps also display self-exciting properties and tend to be associated with recessions, rather than predict future recessionary periods.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用Hawkes过程建模银行股票左尾回报的跳跃行为，发现跳跃具有自激特性。TARP计划能立即降低银行的条件跳跃强度和系统性风险敏感性，但EGRRCPA法案无显著效果。系统性跳跃主要与衰退期相关而非预测衰退。
AI.research_question: 银行股票左尾回报的跳跃行为如何表现出自激特性？TARP和EGRRCPA政策对银行系统性风险有何不同影响？系统性跳跃与宏观经济衰退的关系是什么？
AI.motivation: 银行系统性风险对金融稳定至关重要，理解银行股票左尾回报的跳跃行为和自激特性有助于评估金融脆弱性。政策干预（如TARP和EGRRCPA）对银行风险的影响需要实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Hawkes过程理论，用于建模具有自激特性的跳跃行为。结合系统性风险理论和政策干预效应分析框架。
AI.method: 使用Hawkes过程建模银行股票左尾回报的跳跃到达过程，分析跳跃强度和持续时间。采用实证方法检验TARP和EGRRCPA政策对银行条件跳跃强度和系统性风险敏感性的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 银行左尾跳跃具有显著自激特性，初始冲击后中位数银行条件跳跃强度升至8.3%，恢复基线需21天。2. TARP能立即降低银行条件跳跃强度和系统性风险敏感性。3. EGRRCPA无显著影响。4. 系统性跳跃主要与衰退期相关，而非预测未来衰退。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Hawkes过程应用于银行系统性风险建模，扩展了金融时间序列分析框架。为理解政策干预对银行风险传导机制提供理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供评估银行系统性风险和政策干预有效性的实证依据。TARP被证明能有效降低银行风险，而EGRRCPA效果有限，这对未来危机应对政策设计具有参考价值。

title: Global Spatiotemporal Multi-Criteria Analysis of Coastal Risk: Current and Future Hot Spots and Clusters
affiliations: Fondazione Eni Enrico Mattei (FEEM) and Ca Foscari University of Venice - Dipartimento di Economia

detail.title: Global Spatiotemporal Multi-Criteria Analysis of Coastal Risk: Current and Future Hot Spots and Clusters

publicationDetails.journalName: FEEM Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Coastal zones are among the environments most threatened by climate change. Although various efforts for global mapping and classification of coastal social and ecological systems have been undertaken, the ability to analyse and describe the spatial heterogeneity and multidimensionality of these phenomena remains limited. In the current study, we developed a methodological framework for assessing risk from extreme sea levels and examined its application at the global level. A multi-criteria analysis method was applied to the current scenario and to two future combinations of shared socioeconomic (SSP2 and 5) and representative concentration pathways (RCP4.5 and 8.5), accounting for risk attitudes. Risk maps derived from multi-criteria analysis aggregation of spatial indicators of hazard, vulnerability, and exposure enabled the identification of global hot spots, comprising large areas facing high levels of risk, mostly located in Northern Europe, SouthEast Asia and Southern USA. Spatial clusters with common risk features were identified and mapped using multivariate analysis. The results contribute to improving the state of the art by providing a synoptic view of global coastal risks. Given the high spatial resolution (1 km), the proposed methods may also be helpful for improving adaptation strategies at the regional and national scales and for facilitating the sharing of solutions between areas with similar situations identified by cluster mapping.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个评估极端海平面风险的全球框架，通过多标准分析识别高风险区域，为区域和国家尺度的适应策略提供支持。
AI.research_question: 如何在全球尺度上评估和分析极端海平面风险的空间异质性和多维性？
AI.motivation: 海岸带是受气候变化威胁最严重的环境之一，现有研究对海岸社会生态系统空间异质性和多维性的分析能力有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于风险理论框架，整合灾害、脆弱性和暴露度三个维度，考虑风险态度，采用多标准分析方法。
AI.method: 开发方法学框架，应用多标准分析方法于当前情景和两种未来情景组合（SSP2/RCP4.5和SSP5/RCP8.5），使用空间指标进行风险制图，并通过多元分析识别空间聚类。
AI.findings: 识别出全球高风险热点区域，主要位于北欧、东南亚和美国南部；通过聚类分析识别出具有共同风险特征的空间集群。
AI.theory_contributions: 改进了海岸风险研究的现状，提供了全球海岸风险的概要视图，增强了空间异质性和多维性分析能力。
AI.practical_contributions: 高空间分辨率（1公里）的方法有助于改进区域和国家尺度的适应策略，促进相似风险区域间的解决方案共享。

title: Induced Innovation in Critical Mineral Saving Technologies
affiliations: University of Milan, University of Insubria, Fondazione Eni Enrico Mattei (FEEM), Milan and University of Milan

detail.title: Induced Innovation in Critical Mineral Saving Technologies

publicationDetails.journalName: FEEM Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper develops a novel text-based approach to identify CRM-saving innovation using patent data and studies how mineral price signals shape the direction of technological change. Using patent data from 1978-2020, we distinguish technologies that rely on CRMs from those that explicitly aim to reduce their use through efficiency improvements, substitution, or recycling. We provide evidence consistent with the induced-innovation hypothesis: higher mineral prices reallocate inventive effort toward CRM-saving technologies, while having little effect on CRM-reliant innovation. The response strengthens over time and is especially pronounced for battery minerals and rare earth elements. These findings are robust to alternative specifications and are reinforced by complementary identification strategies, including a falsification test and the use of plausibly exogenous supply-side price variation.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种基于文本的方法，利用专利数据识别关键原材料节约型创新，并研究矿产价格信号如何影响技术变革方向。研究发现，更高的矿产价格会重新分配创新努力，使其转向节约型技术，但对依赖型创新影响不大。
AI.research_question: 矿产价格信号如何影响关键原材料节约型技术创新的方向？
AI.motivation: 理解价格信号如何引导技术创新方向对于资源可持续利用和应对关键原材料供应风险具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 诱导创新假说：价格信号会引导创新活动向节约稀缺资源的方向发展。
AI.method: 基于文本的专利分析方法（1978-2020年专利数据），区分依赖关键原材料的技术与旨在减少其使用的技术（通过效率提升、替代或回收）。使用多种识别策略，包括证伪检验和供应侧价格变化的外生性分析。
AI.findings: 更高的矿产价格会重新分配创新努力，使其转向关键原材料节约型技术，但对依赖型创新影响不大。这种效应随时间增强，在电池矿产和稀土元素方面尤为明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 为诱导创新假说提供了实证支持，展示了价格信号如何具体影响技术创新的方向性变化。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了通过价格机制引导技术创新方向的依据，有助于促进关键原材料的可持续利用和供应安全。

title: Escaping from the Shadow of Government Debt: Evidence from M&A in China
affiliations: University of South Florida - Department of Finance, Loyola Marymount University - Department of Finance,  and Beijing Jiaotong University - School of Economics and Management

detail.title: Escaping from the Shadow of Government Debt: Evidence from M&A in China
detail.abstract: Using a sample of Chinese firms, we find a positive relation between the local government debt (LGD) and firms' acquisition activities. This relation remains robust after addressing endogeneity concerns using an instrumental variable and a quasi-natural experiment centered on the introduction of the New Budget Law. Firms in cities with higher LGD are more likely to acquire targets in cities with lower LGD, consistent with China's geographically segmented credit markets where municipal borrowing takes up local bank credit supply. We consequently observe a significant improvement in the acquiring firms' external financing accessibility postacquisition and an increase in their bank borrowing after the acquisition. Our study offers novel evidence on how firms respond to rising government debt and suggests that it is associated with the geographic reallocation of corporate control.

AI.tldr: 研究发现中国地方政府债务与企业并购活动呈正相关，地方政府债务越高，企业越倾向于并购债务较低地区的目标公司，这改善了并购后企业的外部融资能力。
AI.research_question: 地方政府债务如何影响企业的并购活动？这种影响是否通过地理信贷市场分割机制发挥作用？
AI.motivation: 随着中国地方政府债务规模不断增长，需要理解其对微观企业行为的影响，特别是企业如何应对地方政府债务上升带来的信贷市场变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于中国地理分割的信贷市场理论，地方政府债务会挤占本地银行信贷供给，促使企业通过跨区域并购获取更好的融资条件。
AI.method: 使用中国上市公司样本，采用工具变量法和准自然实验（新预算法实施）解决内生性问题，分析地方政府债务与企业并购的关系。
AI.findings: 1. 地方政府债务与企业并购活动呈正相关；2. 高债务地区企业更倾向于并购低债务地区目标；3. 并购后企业外部融资可获得性显著改善，银行借款增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统揭示了地方政府债务通过地理信贷市场分割影响企业并购行为的机制，拓展了政府债务与企业行为关系的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业应对地方政府债务风险提供战略参考，为政策制定者理解政府债务对实体经济的影响提供实证依据。

reference: Bielefeld Working Papers in Economics and Management No. 04-2026
title: Does Inequality Harm the Climate? An Agent-Based Model with Endogenous Climate Policy
affiliations: Bielefeld University and Bielefeld University - Department of Business Administration and Economics

detail.title: Does Inequality Harm the Climate? An Agent-Based Model with Endogenous Climate Policy

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bielefeld Working Papers in Economics and Management No. 04-2026
publicationDetails.journalName: Bielefeld Working Papers in Economics & Management

detail.abstract: This paper examines how income inequality affects environmental outcomes through the interplay of household consumption and political support for climate policy. We develop an agent-based model in which households differ by income, consumption patterns, and climate policy attitudes. Our results show that the relationship between inequality and emissions is dynamic and non-monotonic: relative to a baseline calibrated to the U.S., lower income inequality initially increases emissions due to rising consumption among formerly low-income households. Over time, however, reduced inequality fosters broader political support for tighter climate action, as a more equal income distribution lowers the relative cost of carbon taxation for households at the bottom of the distribution. This stronger support enables more ambitious policies and ultimately reduces emissions. Moreover, we find that lower inequality consistently produces the lowest cumulative emissions across scenarios. The findings highlight the importance of distributional considerations in designing effective and politically sustainable climate policies.

AI.tldr: 收入不平等通过家庭消费和政治支持两条路径影响环境结果：降低不平等初期会增加排放（低收入家庭消费增加），但长期会增强气候政策支持度，最终降低排放。降低不平等在所有情景中都能产生最低的累积排放。
AI.research_question: 收入不平等如何通过家庭消费和政治支持的相互作用影响环境结果？
AI.motivation: 理解不平等与环境结果之间的关系，为设计既有效又具有政治可持续性的气候政策提供分布性考量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于代理的模型，考虑家庭在收入、消费模式和气候政策态度上的差异，分析不平等通过消费效应和政治支持效应影响环境结果的机制。
AI.method: 开发基于代理的模型，模拟不同收入水平家庭的消费行为和政策态度，以美国为基准进行校准，分析不平等变化对环境结果的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 不平等与排放的关系是动态且非单调的；2. 降低不平等初期会增加排放（低收入家庭消费增加）；3. 长期来看，更平等的收入分配增强气候政策政治支持度；4. 降低不平等在所有情景中产生最低累积排放。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了不平等影响环境结果的双重机制（消费效应和政治支持效应），提出了动态非单调关系理论框架，强调了分布性因素在环境政策分析中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了设计有效且政治可持续的气候政策的依据，强调需要考虑收入分配对政策接受度和环境结果的影响，支持将不平等降低作为长期气候战略的一部分。

title: Blockchain and Tokenization: Will They Actually Democratize Private Markets? A Critical Analysis of Technological Enablers and Structural Constraints
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Blockchain and Tokenization: Will They Actually Democratize Private Markets? A Critical Analysis of Technological Enablers and Structural Constraints
detail.abstract: Until recently, Private Markets-consisting of Private Equity, Real Estate, & Private Credithave historically only been available to large-scale institutional and individual accredited investors (high minimum investments, long minimum investment lock-ups, low liquidity). Blockchain-based tokenization technology is now being promoted as a key enabler to help democratise access to these Private Markets through enabling fractional ownership, programmability of compliance requirements and the continuous settlement of these fractional ownership interests. This paper will examine whether tokenized Private Markets actually achieve their purported goal of democratizing access to them. To that end, we have used multiple means: analysis of market conditions, evaluation of recent regulatory developments, analysis of existing technical standards and creation of structural critiques. We conclude that until these foundational issues are resolved, democratization of Private Markets will remain fragmented and inconsistent-creating a wide variety of effects on Platform Providers, Retail Investors, and Policymakers.

AI.tldr: 区块链代币化技术被宣传为通过实现碎片化所有权、合规要求的可编程性以及持续结算来帮助民主化私人市场准入，但本文研究发现，在基础问题解决之前，这种民主化将是碎片化且不一致的。
AI.research_question: 代币化的私人市场是否真正实现了其宣称的民主化准入目标？
AI.motivation: 私人市场（私募股权、房地产、私人信贷）传统上只对大型机构投资者和合格个人投资者开放，区块链代币化技术被宣传为能够通过碎片化所有权、合规可编程性和持续结算来民主化这些市场准入，但需要验证这种宣传是否属实。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融民主化理论、区块链技术应用理论、监管科技理论、市场准入理论
AI.method: 采用多种方法：市场条件分析、近期监管发展评估、现有技术标准分析、结构批判创建
AI.findings: 在基础问题解决之前，私人市场的民主化将保持碎片化和不一致，对平台提供商、零售投资者和政策制定者产生广泛影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 对区块链技术民主化金融市场的理论承诺进行了批判性评估，提出了实现真正民主化的结构性障碍理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台提供商提供了市场发展现状的洞察，为零售投资者揭示了投资风险，为政策制定者提供了监管改进建议。

title: Quantifying Values: The Problem of AI Risk
affiliations: United States Naval Academy, Yale University - Digital Ethics Center and Polytechnic University of Milan

detail.title: Quantifying Values: The Problem of AI Risk
detail.abstract: Recent AI regulations require deployers of high-risk systems to assess impacts on values like fundamental rights and other legally protected interests. However, existing practice-most notably Fundamental Rights Impact Assessments (FRIAs) under the EU AI Actremains mostly limited to qualitative guidelines. As a result, risk evaluation can be inconsistent and highly variable across assessments. To address this issue, we propose a reference model for value-impact assessment that specifies the core components that any more detailed formalization should incorporate. The model builds on a classical risk paradigm, integrating distinct measures for hazard, exposure, vulnerability, and response or mitigation. We use the EU AI Act's FRIA as a reference case for applying the model to AI risk assessments. The model provides three especially salient recommendations. First, it rejects purely ordinal risk matrices in favor of geometric or ratio-scaled severity ladders, enabling the coherent calculation of expected risk. Second, in analyzing risk mitigation measures, it requires separate estimates of efficacy and reliability, with explicit success criteria and scope conditions that allow for dynamic updating. Third, the model operationalizes regulatory precaution, or risk appetite, through the integration of tail-sensitive risk metrics (e.g., Conditional Value-at-Risk). This lets regulators give appropriate weight to low-probability, high-impact (or catastrophic) harms to fundamental rights without distorting ordinary expected-risk calculations. The result is a structured foundation for more consistent value-impact assessments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个价值影响评估参考模型，基于经典风险范式，整合危害、暴露、脆弱性和应对措施，为AI风险评估提供结构化基础，特别推荐使用比例尺度严重性阶梯、分离效能与可靠性估计、以及尾部敏感风险指标。
AI.research_question: 如何建立一个结构化、一致性的价值影响评估模型来改进AI高风险系统的风险评估实践？
AI.motivation: 现有AI风险评估实践（如欧盟AI法案下的基本权利影响评估）主要局限于定性指南，导致评估结果不一致且变化大，需要更系统化的方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于经典风险范式，整合危害、暴露、脆弱性和应对措施四个核心组件，构建价值影响评估的参考模型。
AI.method: 提出理论参考模型，以欧盟AI法案的FRIA为参考案例，应用模型到AI风险评估中，提供具体操作建议。
AI.findings: 模型提供三个关键建议：1) 使用几何或比例尺度严重性阶梯替代纯序数风险矩阵；2) 分离风险缓解措施的效能和可靠性估计；3) 通过尾部敏感风险指标操作化监管预防原则。
AI.theory_contributions: 为价值影响评估提供了结构化理论框架，将经典风险范式应用于AI监管领域，提出了可计算预期风险的方法论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI风险评估提供具体操作指南，帮助监管机构和部署者进行更一致、可比较的评估，特别关注低概率高影响的基本权利损害。

title: The Limitations of Moore's R", a Variable-Drift Fokker-Planck Option Model
affiliations: University of Toledo

detail.title: The Limitations of Moore's R", a Variable-Drift Fokker-Planck Option Model
detail.abstract: Based on Gary Moore's research (SSRN 2023, 2025), "Moore's R" is a variable-drift Fokker-Planck option model designed to improve upon the Black-Scholes model by better fitting "normal" period option chains such as the Rubinstein data set through a discounted cash flow (DCF) approach.. While it provides more accurate hedge ratios, betas, and explains the volatility smirk as a rational outcome of DCF pricing, its core limitation concerning discontinuities is that it is fundamentally a continuous model.

AI.tldr: Moore's R是一个基于贴现现金流方法的变漂移Fokker-Planck期权模型，旨在改进Black-Scholes模型，能更好地拟合正常时期的期权链数据，提供更准确的对冲比率和贝塔值，并将波动率微笑解释为DCF定价的理性结果，但其核心限制是作为连续模型无法处理不连续性。
AI.research_question: Moore's R模型如何通过贴现现金流方法和变漂移Fokker-Planck框架改进传统Black-Scholes模型，特别是在拟合正常时期期权链数据、提高对冲比率和贝塔值准确性，以及解释波动率微笑现象方面的效果如何？
AI.motivation: 传统Black-Scholes模型在拟合实际期权市场数据（如Rubinstein数据集）时存在局限性，特别是在解释波动率微笑现象和提供准确对冲比率方面。需要开发一个基于更合理经济基础（贴现现金流）的模型来改进这些不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于贴现现金流（DCF）定价理论，结合变漂移Fokker-Planck方程框架，构建连续时间期权定价模型。该框架将波动率微笑视为DCF定价的理性结果，而非市场异常。
AI.method: 采用变漂移Fokker-Planck方程作为数学工具，通过贴现现金流方法构建期权定价模型。使用Rubinstein等正常时期的期权链数据进行实证检验，评估模型在拟合数据、计算对冲比率和贝塔值方面的表现。
AI.findings: Moore's R模型相比Black-Scholes模型能更好地拟合正常时期的期权链数据，提供更准确的对冲比率和贝塔值，并能将波动率微笑解释为贴现现金流定价的理性结果。然而，作为连续模型，它在处理市场不连续性方面存在根本性限制。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）将贴现现金流方法引入期权定价框架；2）通过变漂移Fokker-Planck方程扩展传统模型；3）为波动率微笑现象提供基于DCF的理性解释理论；4）建立了连续时间DCF期权定价的新范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为期权交易者提供更准确的对冲比率计算工具；2）改善投资组合的贝塔值估计；3）为风险管理提供更可靠的定价模型；4）帮助理解波动率微笑的市场含义，指导交易策略。

reference: Central Bank of Malta Working Paper 1/2026
title: The Impact of Malta's Free Childcare Scheme on Female Employment
affiliations: Central Bank of Malta

detail.title: The Impact of Malta's Free Childcare Scheme on Female Employment

publicationDetails.detailsText: Central Bank of Malta Working Paper 1/2026
publicationDetails.journalName: Central Bank of Malta Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This study evaluates the impact of Malta’s 2014 childcare reform, a universal Free Childcare Scheme for children aged 3 months to 3 years, on female employment. Using a difference-in-differences (DD) framework and matched DD models, I find that the reform may have increased the probability of female employment by 1.3–2.4 percentage points, with effects growing over time. Heterogeneity analyses reveal that employment gains were disproportionately concentrated among single mothers and mothers with multiple children, i.e., subgroups that have historically faced greater structural barriers to employment. Notably, the reform likely helped reduce pre-existing employment gaps by up to 26% for single mothers, 39.3% for two-child mothers and 14.1% for mothers with three or more children. However, no persistent employment effects were observed post-eligibility, and fiscal savings were limited to reduced welfare claims among single parents. These findings contribute to the global literature on childcare subsidies by highlighting how nation-wide access, when subject to well-designed eligibility criteria, can narrow labour market disparities, while also showing that persistent employment effects require sustained support beyond the early childhood years.

AI.tldr: 马耳他2014年实施的面向3个月至3岁儿童的全民免费托儿计划，使女性就业概率提高了1.3-2.4个百分点，效果随时间增强。就业增长主要集中在单亲母亲和多子女母亲等传统就业障碍较大的群体，显著缩小了就业差距。但资格到期后无持续就业效应，财政节约仅限于单亲父母的福利申领减少。
AI.research_question: 马耳他2014年全民免费托儿计划改革对女性就业有何影响？该政策如何影响不同母亲群体的就业差距？
AI.motivation: 评估全民免费托儿政策对女性就业的实际效果，特别是对面临更大结构性就业障碍的群体（如单亲母亲和多子女母亲）的影响，为全球托儿补贴政策设计提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于托儿补贴与女性就业关系的理论框架，关注政策如何通过降低托儿成本影响劳动力供给决策，特别关注结构性障碍对就业的影响。
AI.method: 采用双重差分法（DD）和匹配双重差分模型，分析政策实施前后女性就业的变化，并进行异质性分析。
AI.findings:
1. 女性就业概率提高1.3-2.4个百分点，效果随时间增强
2. 就业增长主要集中在单亲母亲和多子女母亲群体
3. 显著缩小就业差距：单亲母亲26%，两个孩子的母亲39.3%，三个及以上孩子母亲14.1%
4. 资格到期后无持续就业效应
5. 财政节约仅限于单亲父母福利申领减少
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 为全民托儿政策对女性就业影响提供新证据
2. 揭示政策对缩小不同母亲群体就业差距的作用机制
3. 强调精心设计的资格标准在减少劳动力市场不平等中的重要性
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者设计托儿补贴提供实证依据
2. 表明全民托儿政策能有效帮助弱势母亲群体就业
3. 指出需要持续支持以维持就业效应
4. 为其他国家类似政策设计提供参考

title:
Optimal Execution with Stochastic Liquidity and Endogenous Volatility Clustering 
A Verification-Theoretic and Riccati-Structured Approach

detail.title:
Optimal Execution with Stochastic Liquidity and Endogenous Volatility Clustering 
A Verification-Theoretic and Riccati-Structured Approach
detail.abstract: We study optimal execution in a continuous-time market where liquidity and volatility co-evolve through a persistent latent factor, producing endogenous volatility clustering and regime-dependent temporary impact. We formulate liquidation as a stochastic control problem with quadratic trading costs and inventory risk. Our contributions are threefold. First, we derive the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) equation and provide a verification theorem that yields an optimal feedback control. Second, we show that the value function admits a quadratic-in-inventory structure, reducing the HJB to a semilinear parabolic equation for a state-dependent Riccati coefficient. This reduction reveals how volatility clustering modifies classical Almgren-Chriss trajectories by inducing stochastic liquidation speeds. Third, we develop stable numerical schemes for the reduced equation and provide simulation evidence that state-adaptive strategies outperform static-impact baselines in clustered regimes. We also discuss calibration of the latent factor from high-frequency proxies and outline extensions to permanent impact and multi-asset execution.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了在流动性和波动率通过潜在因子共同演化的市场中，考虑波动率聚类效应下的最优执行问题，提出了状态自适应策略并证明其在聚类机制中优于静态基准。
AI.research_question: 在流动性和波动率通过持久潜在因子共同演化、产生内生波动率聚类的市场中，如何优化执行策略以最小化交易成本和库存风险？
AI.motivation: 传统最优执行模型通常假设流动性和波动率是静态或外生的，忽略了实际市场中波动率聚类现象和流动性的状态依赖性，需要开发更符合市场微观结构的动态模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于连续时间市场模型，结合随机控制理论、Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman方程、Almgren-Chriss框架，以及状态依赖的二次交易成本和库存风险。
AI.method: 将清仓问题构建为具有二次交易成本和库存风险的随机控制问题，推导HJB方程并提供验证定理，通过二次结构简化方程，开发稳定的数值方案并进行模拟分析。

detail.abstract: Objective. To determine whether combat pay for U.S. Army officers has been adequate to maintain troop strength during wartime in the all-volunteer military. Methods. Data from a panel survey of 3,800 officers collected one year prior to Operation Desert Storm and again during the Iraqi engagement are used. The primary economic indicator of work disutility-the marginal rate of substitution (MRS) or tradeoff of time for money-is estimated; and the MRS-hourly pay relationship in both time periods is determined. Results. Combat pay was found to be generally adequate to offset increases in wartime disutility. Additional payment was required for male officers in only two branch groups, and these involved relatively small numbers of personnel compared to the larger Combat Arms branches. Conclusions. We find no evidence that a market oriented volunteer army could not maintain adequate troop strength during wartime, at least in environments similar to that of the early 1990s when these data were collected.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了美国陆军军官的战斗津贴是否足以在战时维持志愿军的兵力水平，发现战斗津贴总体上能补偿战时工作负效用，只有少数分支的男性军官需要额外津贴。
AI.research_question: 美国陆军军官的战斗津贴是否足以在战时维持志愿军的兵力水平？
AI.motivation: 在志愿军制度下，确保战时兵力充足至关重要，需要评估战斗津贴是否能有效补偿军官在战时的额外风险和负效用。

AI.theory_contributions: 为志愿军制度下的战时人力经济学提供了实证支持，验证了市场导向的薪酬机制在维持战时兵力方面的有效性。

detail.title: Corruption and Legal Gender Inequalities

declarations.funderStatement: Giovanna Rodríguez-García is supported by the project “Gender and Corruption: Laboratory Experiments in Colombian Universities,” funded by the Colombian Institute for Educational Credit and Technical Studies Abroad (ICETEX).

detail.abstract: This chapter explores the ways in which corruption can undermine gender equality by creating barriers to justice and obstructing legal equality for women. Corruption in the judiciary, law enforcement, and other legal institutions disproportionately affects women, limiting their access to fair and impartial justice. Women, particularly those from marginalized backgrounds, often face demands for bribes, sexual favors, or bureaucratic hurdles when attempting to claim their legal rights or seek protection from abuse. Such practices erode women's confidence in the justice system and exacerbate gender inequality by preventing women from achieving redress, protecting their rights, and gaining equal representation under the law. Furthermore, corruption enables discriminatory practices, allowing perpetrators of gender-based violence or discrimination to evade accountability. Using the V-DEM Political Corruption Index and the Exclusion by Gender Index, we present impulse response functions from panel vector autoregression models, which show that increases in corruption lead to greater legal inequalities for women. We conclude with some suggestions for effective policies to fight corruption and promote legal equality.

detail.abstract: This comprehensive study analyzes explicit subsidies across seven Indian states - Andhra Pradesh, Punjab, Rajasthan, Odisha, Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal, and Nagaland - examining their impact on state finances. The research reveals that states spending over 20% of revenue receipts on explicit subsidies face significant revenue deficits, while those maintaining subsidies below 15% show revenue surpluses. Notably, states like Punjab and Andhra Pradesh demonstrate high subsidy expenditure, primarily on power, agriculture, and welfare schemes, while Odisha and Uttar Pradesh maintain more sustainable levels. The study proposes using the TTTE Formula (Targeting, Transparency, Timeline, and Evaluation) for subsidy rationalization and emphasizes linking subsidy volumes to available fiscal space. Our findings suggest that uncontrolled subsidy growth, especially in revenue-deficit states, threatens fiscal sustainability and reduces capital expenditure, offering valuable insights for policymakers on subsidy rationalization while maintaining essential welfare objectives.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了印度七个邦的显性补贴对财政的影响，发现补贴支出超过财政收入20%的邦面临严重财政赤字，而低于15%的邦则有财政盈余。研究提出TTTE公式（目标定位、透明度、时间表和评估）来合理化补贴，并建议将补贴规模与可用财政空间挂钩。
AI.research_question: 印度各邦的显性补贴支出如何影响其财政状况？如何通过补贴合理化来平衡财政可持续性与基本福利目标？

AI.method: 对印度七个邦（安得拉邦、旁遮普邦、拉贾斯坦邦、奥里萨邦、北方邦、西孟加拉邦和那加兰邦）的显性补贴进行综合分析，比较不同邦的补贴支出占财政收入的比例及其对财政赤字/盈余的影响。

title: Dynamic Capacity Management: Implications for Operating, Investing, and Financing Activities
affiliations: University of Georgia - Terry College of Business, University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) - Anderson School of Management, University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) and

detail.title: Dynamic Capacity Management: Implications for Operating, Investing, and Financing Activities
detail.abstract: Firms adjust operating capacity via substantial acquisitions, expansions, divestitures, and spin-offs, and exert significant search effort identifying opportunities to do so cost effectively. We embed capacity adjustment and search in a dynamic model to understand how they interact with the firm's operating decisions (risk-management), financing decisions (distributions and capital raises), and liquidity (cash position). We find that capacity-related search efforts are U-shaped in firm liquidity: highest when firms have either small or large cash positions. The firm's costly efforts to mitigate operational risk move with capacityrelated search (acting as strategic complements) when liquidity is low and diverge (acting as substitutes) when liquidity is high. We provide testable predictions related to the frequency of major capacity adjustments, net capacity growth, payout timing, cash-flow volatility, and capital raises. We also relate our predictions to firm life cycle classifications based on firms' cash flows.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了一个动态模型，将产能调整和搜索活动与企业运营决策（风险管理）、融资决策（分配和资本筹集）以及流动性（现金头寸）相结合。研究发现产能相关搜索努力与企业流动性呈U型关系，且风险缓解努力与产能搜索在低流动性时互补，在高流动性时替代。
AI.research_question: 企业产能调整和搜索活动如何与运营决策（风险管理）、融资决策（分配和资本筹集）以及流动性（现金头寸）相互作用？

AI.findings: 1. 产能相关搜索努力与企业流动性呈U型关系：当企业现金头寸较小或较大时搜索努力最高；2. 风险缓解努力与产能搜索在低流动性时作为战略互补，在高流动性时作为替代；3. 提供了关于重大产能调整频率、净产能增长、派息时机、现金流波动性和资本筹集的可检验预测。
