title: "B" is for "Big Gifts": Characterizing Donor-Recipient Charitable Relationships using Form 990 Schedule B
affiliations: University of Southern California,  and

detail.title: "B" is for "Big Gifts": Characterizing Donor-Recipient Charitable Relationships using Form 990 Schedule B
detail.abstract: Research on charitable giving has been limited by scarce information on large donors and by a lack of data linking donors to recipient organizations. We address both gaps in the literature by applying machine learning methods to a novel administrative data source: IRS Form 990 Schedule B. This allows us to produce the first comprehensive map of donor-recipient relationships among major contributors over time. Using this mapping, we describe the distribution of large charitable gifts by donor type, linked recipient type, charity size, gift size, gift medium (cash versus noncash), and geography.

AI.tldr: 利用机器学习分析IRS税务数据，首次绘制了大型慈善捐赠者与受赠组织关系的全面图谱，揭示了捐赠模式的多维度分布特征。
AI.research_question: 大型慈善捐赠者与受赠组织之间的关系模式是什么？这些捐赠在不同维度（捐赠者类型、受赠组织类型、慈善机构规模、捐赠规模、捐赠媒介、地理分布）上如何分布？
AI.motivation: 现有慈善捐赠研究存在两大局限：1）缺乏大型捐赠者的详细信息；2）缺少将捐赠者与受赠组织联系起来的数据。这些信息缺口限制了我们对慈善捐赠生态系统的理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 慈善捐赠研究、捐赠者行为理论、组织间关系理论、慈善生态系统理论
AI.method: 应用机器学习方法分析IRS Form 990 Schedule B行政数据，构建捐赠者-受赠组织关系图谱，进行多维度描述性分析。
AI.findings: 首次全面绘制了主要捐赠者与受赠组织的关系网络，揭示了捐赠在捐赠者类型、受赠组织类型、慈善机构规模、捐赠规模、捐赠媒介（现金与非现金）和地理分布等多个维度上的分布特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了慈善捐赠研究中关于大型捐赠者和捐赠者-受赠组织关系的数据空白，为理解慈善生态系统提供了新的理论视角和数据基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为慈善机构、政策制定者和研究人员提供了前所未有的捐赠网络洞察，有助于优化筹款策略、制定更有效的慈善政策，并促进慈善领域的透明度。

title: Institutional Asset Pricing with Segmentation and Household Heterogeneity
affiliations: Rotman School of Management, University of Toronto, Princeton University and

detail.title: Institutional Asset Pricing with Segmentation and Household Heterogeneity
detail.abstract: How do household frictions impact the portfolios of the financial sector and which households gain and lose as a result? To answer this question, we build a heterogeneousagent macro-finance model with households facing asset market participation constraints, banks providing deposits, funds providing insurance/pension products, and endogenous asset price volatility. We solve the model globally by developing a novel deep learning methodology for macro-finance models and calibrate the model to asset pricing dynamics and household portfolio choices. Counterfactual experiments reveal policy trade-offs. Tighter financial sector restrictions increase stability but at the expense of lower growth and/or higher inequality because richer households are better able to take advantage of the higher spreads created by the regulations.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了一个异质性代理人宏观金融模型，分析家庭摩擦如何影响金融部门投资组合，以及哪些家庭从中获益或受损。研究发现更严格的金融部门监管虽然增加稳定性，但会降低增长并加剧不平等。
AI.research_question: 家庭摩擦如何影响金融部门的投资组合配置？哪些家庭因此获益或受损？
AI.motivation: 理解家庭层面的市场参与约束如何通过金融部门传导到整个经济，以及金融监管政策在不同家庭群体间的分配效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 异质性代理人宏观金融模型，包含家庭资产市场参与约束、银行提供存款、基金提供保险/养老金产品，以及内生资产价格波动。
AI.method: 开发了新颖的深度学习方法来全局求解宏观金融模型，并将模型校准到资产定价动态和家庭投资组合选择数据。
AI.findings: 更严格的金融部门限制虽然增加稳定性，但以降低增长和/或加剧不平等为代价，因为富裕家庭更有能力利用监管创造的高利差机会。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 构建了包含家庭摩擦和金融部门异质性的综合宏观金融模型；2) 开发了用于求解此类模型的深度学习新方法；3) 揭示了金融监管在稳定与分配效应间的权衡。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了评估金融监管政策分配效应的分析框架，强调了在追求金融稳定时需要考虑对增长和不平等的影响。

title: The Russia-Ukraine Conflict and Eurozone Sovereign Risk: A Yield Net Analysis
affiliations: China University of Political Science and Law and Xiamen University - Wang Yanan Institute for Studies in Economics (WISE)

detail.title: The Russia-Ukraine Conflict and Eurozone Sovereign Risk: A Yield Net Analysis
detail.abstract: This paper examines how the Russia-Ukraine geopolitical risk (GPR) transmits to Eurozone sovereign bond yields using an affine macro-finance yield net model. We find GPR shocks raise inflation expectations immediately with significance and persistence, subsequently lifting sovereign yields most sharply at the medium term, explaining about 30% of yield variation at a five-year horizon. Surprisingly, transmission is strongest in fiscally robust members, not high-debt countries. This pattern aligns with national commitments to Ukraine, revealing that direct fiscal engagements--enabled by their fiscal space--drive risk pricing, underscoring the monetary-fiscal trade-offs facing policymakers under geopolitical stress.

AI.tldr: 本文使用仿射宏观金融收益率网络模型研究俄乌地缘政治风险如何传导至欧元区主权债券收益率。研究发现GPR冲击会立即显著且持续地推高通胀预期，进而导致中期主权收益率最急剧上升，在五年期解释约30%的收益率变动。令人惊讶的是，传导效应在财政稳健成员国最强而非高债务国家，这与各国对乌克兰的承诺模式一致，表明直接财政参与（由其财政空间驱动）推动了风险定价，凸显了地缘政治压力下政策制定者面临的货币-财政权衡。
AI.research_question: 俄乌地缘政治风险如何传导至欧元区主权债券收益率？这种传导机制在不同财政状况的成员国间有何差异？
AI.motivation: 理解地缘政治风险对主权债券市场的影响机制，特别是在欧元区这样的货币联盟中，不同财政状况成员国如何应对共同的地缘政治冲击，对政策制定和风险管理具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于仿射宏观金融收益率网络模型，结合通胀预期传导机制和财政空间理论，分析地缘政治风险通过财政承诺渠道影响主权债券定价的过程。
AI.method: 采用仿射宏观金融收益率网络模型（affine macro-finance yield net model），分析俄乌地缘政治风险冲击对欧元区主权债券收益率的传导效应，特别关注不同财政状况成员国的异质性反应。
AI.findings: 1. GPR冲击立即显著且持续地推高通胀预期；2. 主权收益率在中期（五年期）上升最急剧，GPR能解释约30%的收益率变动；3. 传导效应在财政稳健成员国最强，而非高债务国家；4. 这种模式与各国对乌克兰的承诺程度一致，表明直接财政参与（由财政空间驱动）是风险定价的关键渠道。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了地缘政治风险通过财政承诺渠道影响主权债券定价的新机制；2. 挑战了传统认为高债务国家更容易受地缘政治冲击影响的观点；3. 提出了在货币联盟中财政空间与地缘政治承诺的交互作用理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了在地缘政治压力下管理货币-财政权衡的实证依据；2. 帮助投资者理解不同财政状况成员国主权债券的风险定价差异；3. 为风险管理提供了关于地缘政治风险传导路径的量化分析框架。

title: Bioenergy Expansion and Spatially Unequal Environmental Impacts
affiliations: National University of Singapore (NUS), Department of Economics

detail.title: Bioenergy Expansion and Spatially Unequal Environmental Impacts

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I have no conflict of interest to declare.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: I receive no funding.

detail.abstract: Renewable energy transitions promise long-run environmental benefits, yet in the short-run they can generate unequal local and nonlocal environmental effects. This paper studies the global impacts of bioenergy expansion by combining worldwide plant-level data, satellitebased measures of air pollution and land use, and international trade flows. I document three main findings. First, bioenergy expansion accelerates coal phase-out and improves local air quality. An annual increase of 1 MW per operating bioenergy plant raises the probability that a coal plant is retired by 1.74 percentage points and, among remaining active plants, reduces surrounding SO2 and AOD by 1.35 percent and 0.24 percent relative to their means. Second, bioenergy expansion increases upstream wood demand, with the same capacity increase raising wood product imports by 0.17 percent. Third, exploiting nationwide biomass policy shocks in Japan and Korea, I show that rising wood exports induce persistent deforestation in Indonesia, Thailand, and Vietnam, implying cumulative forest loss of 18,000 km2 over the eight-year post-policy period. My findings highlight a tradeoff in the energy transition that bioenergy policies deliver local environmental gains while inducing environmental damage upstream through international supply chains.

detail.abstract:
Stablecoins—digital tokens backed by fiat currency and high-quality liquid assets—represent an important step in the modernization of payment and settlement systems. When governed by clear prudential standards, they hold the potential to enhance payment efficiency, liquidity management, and transparency across the financial system. The GENIUS Act establishes an initial regulatory framework for stablecoin issuance in the United States by mandating full reserve backing, enforceable redemption rights, and standardized disclosures—features that aim to align stablecoin activity with long-standing financial stability and consumer protection objectives.

Despite prior concerns expressed in popular press or casual industry reports, empirical evidence and recent theoretical studies indicate that, under such a framework, stablecoins may complement rather than disrupt the traditional banking system. Deposit erosion or systemic risks depend critically on underlying economic frictions—particularly deposit-rate stickiness, search costs, and reserve composition—and available evidence suggests that these risks appear limited under the new regulatory landscape. To date, stablecoin adoption has not produced meaningful aggregate outflows from traditional bank deposits. Moreover, under realistic yield environments consistent with the GENIUS Act, competition from regulated stablecoin issuers may reinforce rather than weaken bank intermediation by encouraging more competitive deposit pricing and more efficient liquidity allocation, provided that regulatory capital frameworks ensure a level playing field between tokenized liabilities and traditional deposits.

Stablecoins also present potential operational and strategic opportunities for incumbent financial institutions. Banks may derive benefits from providing custody and reserve-management services for issuers, managing associated high-quality liquid assets, or developing tokenized liabilities within prudential constraints. Integrating these functions—either directly or through partnerships with stablecoin issuers—may allow institutions to adapt existing business models to a broader, more digital ecosystem while maintaining customer relationships and operational continuity.

Importantly, the GENIUS Act’s safeguards are poised to address the key vulnerabilities identified in the literature, including run and liquidity risk. Full one-to-one backing in high-quality liquid assets (cash, Treasury bills, and deposits at insured depositories), legally enforceable par-value redemption rights, and standardized public disclosure of reserves reduce uncertainty about issuers’ solvency and liquidity, thereby lowering the likelihood of run-like redemption pressures. As adoption grows and markets for stablecoins deepen, broader institutional participation and reputation effects may further support peg stability in normal market conditions. Stablecoins may also support financial stability more broadly: their demand for safe assets can deepen these markets, and under stress, regulated stablecoins may channel flows toward high-quality liquid assets, subject to the absorption capacity of Treasury markets. In addition, tokenized, on-chain settlement can potentially improve operational resilience and reduce counterparty risk, particularly in cross-border transactions.

Looking ahead, collaboration between regulators, financial institutions, and technology providers will remain critical for ensuring that innovation proceeds within a safe and transparent framework. Naturally, residual risks remain, as no policy framework can eliminate them entirely. For example, reserve-only regimes remain exposed to extreme but low-probability shocks to safe-asset markets and to operational failures at custodial institutions. However, these vulnerabilities appear broadly comparable to those faced by other financial institutions and financial innovations in the past, and have been studied. Careful regulatory designs, not outright bans without a thorough understanding of the underlying economics, are needed.

Overall, with prudent oversight, issuer diversification, and consistent global standards, well-regulated stablecoins may serve as a durable, interoperable payment instrument integrated into the existing financial system, advancing its infrastructure, inclusion, and resilience in both theory and practice.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了在GENIUS法案监管框架下，稳定币如何与传统银行系统互补而非颠覆，探讨了稳定币对金融稳定、支付效率和银行中介的潜在积极影响。
AI.research_question: 在GENIUS法案建立的监管框架下，稳定币如何影响传统银行系统和金融稳定？稳定币是否能与传统金融系统互补而非颠覆？
AI.motivation: 稳定币作为现代化支付结算系统的重要创新，面临监管不确定性。公众和行业报告担心稳定币可能侵蚀银行存款或引发系统性风险，需要实证证据和理论分析来评估在明确监管框架下的实际影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于金融稳定理论、银行中介理论、支付系统现代化理论，以及存款利率粘性、搜索成本、储备构成等经济摩擦因素的分析框架。
AI.method: 结合实证证据分析（稳定币采用未导致银行存款显著外流）、理论模型分析（基于GENIUS法案监管框架）、比较分析（与传统金融风险比较）和政策分析。
AI.findings: 1. 在GENIUS法案监管下，稳定币未导致银行存款显著外流；2. 监管稳定币可能通过促进存款竞争定价和流动性配置效率来强化银行中介；3. 稳定币为传统金融机构提供托管、储备管理等新业务机会；4. GENIUS法案的保障措施能有效应对挤兑和流动性风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 构建了监管框架下稳定币与传统金融系统关系的理论分析框架；2. 挑战了稳定币必然颠覆传统银行的流行观点；3. 提出了稳定币可能增强金融稳定的理论机制；4. 扩展了数字时代支付系统现代化的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供基于证据的监管建议；2. 为金融机构识别稳定币相关业务机会；3. 为全球稳定币标准制定提供参考；4. 促进支付系统现代化和金融包容性；5. 指导监管设计而非简单禁止的创新路径。

title: A Pedagogical Framework for Agent-Based Simulation in Excel Using Euler-Cromer and Runge-Kutta Solutions
affiliations: Bradley University - Department of Finance and Bradley University

detail.title: A Pedagogical Framework for Agent-Based Simulation in Excel Using Euler-Cromer and Runge-Kutta Solutions
detail.abstract: Purpose This paper presents an accessible, pedagogically grounded framework for introducing agent-based modeling in finance using Microsoft Excel. The objective is to lower the entry barrier to complex-systems simulation by demonstrating how dynamic agent interactions can be modeled without requiring advanced programming skills. Design/methodology/approach The manuscript develops numerical solutions to agent-based models using the Euler-Cromer and Runge-Kutta methods and demonstrates their implementation within Excel spreadsheets. The approach simulates heterogeneous agent behavior, iterative state transitions, and emergent macro-level patterns, with emphasis on conceptual understanding through structured numerical experimentation. Findings The paper demonstrates that complex econophysics concepts, specifically agent-based simulations solved via Euler-Cromer and Runge-Kutta methods, can be modeled effectively in Microsoft Excel. This establishes Excel as a viable platform for implementing sophisticated dynamic simulations, thereby making agent-based modeling accessible as a pedagogical tool for undergraduate and graduate finance education. Originality This study is among the first to offer a systematic pedagogical framework for implementing agent-based financial models entirely in Excel. By eliminating the reliance on specialized programming environments, the framework broadens access to computational finance methods and enables instructors to incorporate modern complexity-based modeling into traditional finance curricula. Practical implications The Excel-based methodology can be seamlessly integrated across finance courses at multiple levels. Students acquire transferable skills in numerical modeling and simulation logic using a familiar software environment, enhancing experiential learning and accessibility to computational techniques within finance education.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Excel的代理建模教学框架，通过数值方法（欧拉-克罗默和龙格-库塔）实现复杂金融系统的动态模拟，降低了计算金融的入门门槛。
AI.research_question: 如何在无需高级编程技能的情况下，在金融教育中引入基于代理的建模方法？
AI.motivation: 降低复杂系统模拟的入门门槛，使金融专业学生能够在熟悉的Excel环境中学习和应用基于代理的建模方法，促进计算金融技术在传统金融课程中的普及。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于代理的建模理论、复杂系统理论、计算金融方法、数值分析理论（欧拉-克罗默和龙格-库塔方法）
AI.method: 开发基于Excel的数值解决方案，使用欧拉-克罗默和龙格-库塔方法实现代理模型的数值求解，通过结构化数值实验模拟异质代理行为、迭代状态转换和涌现的宏观模式。
AI.findings: 研究表明，复杂的经济物理概念（特别是通过欧拉-克罗默和龙格-库塔方法求解的基于代理的模拟）可以在Microsoft Excel中有效建模。Excel成为实现复杂动态模拟的可行平台，使基于代理的建模成为金融教育中可访问的教学工具。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供了在Excel中完全实现基于代理金融模型的系统性教学框架；将复杂系统理论与传统金融教育相结合；扩展了计算金融方法在金融教育中的应用范围。
AI.practical_contributions: Excel方法可以无缝整合到多个层次的金融课程中；学生可以在熟悉的软件环境中获得数值建模和模拟逻辑的可转移技能；增强了金融教育中计算技术的体验式学习和可访问性。

title: Gender Ideology and Work-Family Conflict: A Global Comparative Analysis
affiliations: Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University, International Institute for Population Sciences and International Institute for Population Sciences (IIPS)

detail.title: Gender Ideology and Work-Family Conflict: A Global Comparative Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Authors declare no conflict of interest
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: None to declare

detail.abstract: Reconciliation of work and family roles has become a central issue for advancing women's empowerment, gender equality, and sustainable family systems worldwide. While the previous research has examined the 'work-family interface', multi-country evidence on the link between gender ideology (GI) and work-family conflict (WFC), remains inconclusive. As GI influences occupational choice and household division of labour, this study investigates a critical question: whether individuals with traditional gender beliefs experience higher WFC than those with egalitarian views. Using data from the ISSP 2012 module 'Family and Changing Gender Roles', we find a positive association between GI scores and WFC, indicating that respondents with traditional beliefs are more likely to report WFC than those with egalitarian ideology. While the findings remain robust across multiple robustness checks, yet the magnitude of the association is far from uniform, showing clear heterogeneity across individual factors such as sex and education, as well as community contexts, including place and region of residence.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现，持有传统性别意识形态的个体比持有平等主义观念的个体更可能经历工作家庭冲突，但这种关联在不同性别、教育水平和社区背景中存在显著异质性。
AI.research_question: 持有传统性别观念的个体是否比持有平等主义观念的个体经历更高的工作家庭冲突？
AI.motivation: 工作与家庭角色的协调已成为推动女性赋权、性别平等和可持续家庭系统的核心问题。现有关于"工作家庭界面"的研究中，关于性别意识形态与工作家庭冲突关系的跨国证据仍不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 性别意识形态理论，工作家庭冲突理论，角色理论
AI.method: 使用ISSP 2012模块"家庭和变化的性别角色"的调查数据，分析性别意识形态得分与工作家庭冲突之间的关系，并进行多重稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 性别意识形态得分与工作家庭冲突呈正相关，表明持有传统观念的受访者比持有平等主义意识形态的受访者更可能报告工作家庭冲突。但这种关联的强度并非均匀，在性别、教育水平等个体因素以及居住地和地区等社区背景中存在明显的异质性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为性别意识形态与工作家庭冲突之间的关系提供了跨国实证证据，揭示了这种关系在不同个体和社区背景中的异质性，丰富了工作家庭界面理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于如何通过改变性别意识形态来减少工作家庭冲突的实证依据，特别强调了需要考虑个体和社区差异来制定针对性的干预措施。

title: Learning from Past Prices: Evidence from the UK Housing Market
affiliations: Warwick Business School

detail.title: Learning from Past Prices: Evidence from the UK Housing Market
detail.abstract: Imperfect knowledge of how information propagates through a market can amplify price responses under social learning. I study this mechanism in the UK housing market using regular, plausibly exogenous shocks to sellers' public information. I exploit the UK Land Registry's monthly publication of transaction prices, introduced in March 2012, and link listings from a large online platform to recently completed comparable sales. Publication increases the sensitivity of asking prices to transactions, and the marginal effect of a given sale rises with the order of subsequent matched listings. This pattern is difficult to reconcile with Bayesian updating under redundant signals and is consistent with redundancy neglect. Sale prices exhibit near one-for-one pass-through of the amplified quote component, with limited offset through listingto-sale discounts or time on market. The findings provide micro-level evidence for belief-based housing price dynamics and disclosure policy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了英国房地产市场信息传播不完善如何放大价格反应。通过利用英国土地注册局每月公布交易价格的政策变化，发现信息公布增加了要价对交易的敏感性，且后续匹配房源越多，单个销售的影响越大。这与贝叶斯更新下的冗余信号理论不符，支持了"冗余忽视"假说。销售价格几乎完全传递了放大的报价成分，对房价动态和披露政策有重要启示。
AI.research_question: 信息传播不完善如何通过社会学习放大房地产市场的价格反应？具体来说，公开信息冲击如何影响要价对已完成交易的敏感性？
AI.motivation: 理解房地产市场信息传播机制对价格形成的影响，特别是当市场参与者对信息传播路径了解不完善时，如何通过社会学习放大价格反应。这对于解释房价动态和设计信息披露政策具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会学习理论、贝叶斯更新模型、冗余信号理论、冗余忽视假说、信息传播与价格形成理论
AI.method: 利用英国土地注册局2012年3月开始每月公布交易价格的政策变化作为准自然实验，将大型在线平台的房源挂牌与近期完成的类似销售进行匹配，采用双重差分等因果推断方法分析信息公布对要价敏感性的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 信息公布增加了要价对已完成交易的敏感性；2. 给定销售对后续匹配房源的影响随房源顺序递增；3. 这种模式难以用贝叶斯更新下的冗余信号理论解释，与冗余忽视一致；4. 销售价格几乎完全传递了放大的报价成分，而通过挂牌折扣或上市时间的抵消作用有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为基于信念的房价动态提供了微观证据；2. 揭示了信息传播不完善如何通过社会学习放大价格反应；3. 挑战了传统贝叶斯更新模型，支持冗余忽视假说；4. 深化了对房地产市场信息处理机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为房地产市场信息披露政策设计提供依据；2. 帮助理解房价波动机制和泡沫形成；3. 为市场参与者提供信息处理策略参考；4. 对房地产市场监管和稳定政策有启示意义。

title: Lost Generations? Fertility and Economic Growth in Europe
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF)

detail.title: Lost Generations? Fertility and Economic Growth in Europe

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: The total fertility rate—the average number of births per woman—in Europe is already at 1.46, which is significantly below the replacement rate of 2.1, where fertility compensates for mortality and thereby the population replaces itself from one generation to the next. Falling fertility rates will have far-reaching social and economic consequences, and therefore it is a critical empirical exercise to estimate the impact of below-replacement fertility on income growth and test quantitatively for the existence of mitigating factors that could inform appropriate policy responses. In this paper, I address the endogeneity bias caused by reverse causality by implementing an instrumental variable approach and use exogenous variation in the comparative abortion index as an instrument for the total fertility rate. These results show that fertility has a significant positive effect on real GDP per capita growth in a sample of 42 European countries over the period 1960–2022. This means that the downward fertility transition across Europe, accompanied by fast-aging population, is a significant drag on income per capita growth.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用工具变量方法分析欧洲42个国家1960-2022年的数据，发现生育率对人均GDP增长有显著正向影响，表明低于更替水平的生育率会拖累经济增长。
AI.research_question: 低于更替水平的生育率如何影响欧洲国家的人均GDP增长？是否存在缓解因素可以指导政策应对？
AI.motivation: 欧洲总和生育率已降至1.46，显著低于2.1的更替水平。生育率下降将带来深远的社会经济后果，需要实证评估其对收入增长的影响并寻找缓解因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人口经济学理论、经济增长理论、人口转型理论、劳动力供给与经济增长关系理论。
AI.method: 采用工具变量方法解决内生性问题，使用比较堕胎指数作为总和生育率的工具变量，分析42个欧洲国家1960-2022年的面板数据。
AI.findings: 生育率对实际人均GDP增长有显著正向影响。欧洲生育率下降和人口快速老龄化显著拖累了人均收入增长。
AI.theory_contributions: 为人口转型与经济增长关系提供了新的因果证据，验证了低生育率对经济增长的负面影响，丰富了人口经济学理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了生育率影响经济增长的量化证据，强调了应对低生育率问题的重要性，为制定促进生育和应对老龄化政策提供了依据。

title: Bootstrapping an Innovation Ecosystem: A Self-Sustaining Framework for Investing in Emerging Technology

detail.title: Bootstrapping an Innovation Ecosystem: A Self-Sustaining Framework for Investing in Emerging Technology

declarations.declarationOfInterest: KB declares no competing financial interest.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was funded by Intellectual Property Ontario.

detail.abstract: Securing socioeconomic value from publicly funded research requires translation of scientific breakthroughs from lab to market. However, many innovation ecosystems lack the patient, risk-tolerant capital required to support the early stages of commercialization. In this work, we simulate the performance of several strategies for investing in early-stage startups attempting to commercialize publicly funded research. We base our model on a dataset comprising the funding history of 9,199 university-affiliated startups in North American and Europe over the last several decades. The results demonstrate quantitatively that broad investment of small amounts of capital in many startups statistically outperforms concentrated investment in fewer companies, and that the long time required to realize returns may be incompatible with typical venture capital funds with 10-year lifetimes. We show that venture philanthropy, where returns from dilutive investment are recycled to support the subsequent innovations, can be an effective source of capital for bringing emerging technologies to market in ecosystems that are presently limited by risk aversion. Our results show that a relatively small amount of initial funding can catalyze an innovation ecosystem that grows exponentially in the long term. This work supports the argument that public sector funding is necessary in the early stages of emerging technology commercialization, and that high failure tolerance is required for securing value from public investment in research. Finally, we find that, provided a large enough number of investments are made, this strategy can be self-sustaining, making it an efficient use of taxpayer dollars to support innovation.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过模拟投资策略发现，对早期大学衍生初创企业进行广泛小额投资比集中投资表现更好，风险慈善模式能有效催化创新生态系统，公共资金在早期商业化阶段至关重要。
AI.research_question: 如何最有效地投资于商业化公共资助研究的早期初创企业？不同投资策略（广泛小额投资 vs 集中投资）在支持大学衍生初创企业商业化方面的表现如何？
AI.motivation: 将公共资助的研究成果从实验室转化为市场价值需要商业化，但许多创新生态系统缺乏支持早期商业化阶段的耐心、风险容忍资本。传统风险投资基金因10年期限限制，难以支持需要长期回报的早期技术商业化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创新生态系统理论、风险投资理论、技术商业化理论、公共资助研究转化理论、风险慈善理论
AI.method: 基于9,199家北美和欧洲大学附属初创企业数十年融资历史数据集，模拟不同早期投资策略的绩效表现，包括广泛小额投资策略与集中投资策略的比较分析。
AI.findings: 1. 广泛小额投资于多家初创企业的策略在统计上优于集中投资于少数公司的策略；2. 实现回报所需时间长，可能与典型10年期风险投资基金不兼容；3. 风险慈善模式（稀释性投资回报再投资于后续创新）能有效为新兴技术市场化提供资本；4. 相对较少的初始资金可以催化长期呈指数增长的创新生态系统；5. 只要投资数量足够大，该策略可以自我维持。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为早期技术商业化投资策略提供了定量证据；2. 发展了风险慈善作为创新生态系统催化剂的理据；3. 扩展了公共资助研究转化理论，强调高失败容忍度的重要性；4. 挑战了传统风险投资模式在长期技术商业化中的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了支持早期技术商业化的有效投资策略；2. 展示了风险慈善模式在资本不足创新生态系统中的应用价值；3. 证明了公共部门资金在早期商业化阶段的必要性；4. 提供了高效使用纳税人资金支持创新的具体方案；5. 为创新生态系统建设者提供了可操作的指导原则。

title: Debt-at-Risk
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF), Centre for Economic Policy Research (CEPR), , International Monetary Fund (IMF) and International Monetary Fund (IMF)

detail.title: Debt-at-Risk

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper proposes a novel framework for analyzing the risks surrounding the public debt outlook, the “Debt-at-Risk.” It employs a quantile panel regression framework to assess how current macrofinancial and political conditions impact the entire spectrum of possible future debt outcomes. Many of these factors—including financial conditions and economic variables such as initial debt and GDP growth—predict both the expected level and the uncertainty of future debt, implying pronounced variations in risks, especially in the upper tail of the distribution. By combining the roles of these factors, we find that in a severely adverse scenario—the 95th percentile of the future debt distribution, or debt-at-risk—global public debt could be approximately 20 percentage points higher than currently projected. The magnitudes and sources of debt risks vary over time and across countries, with high initial debt amplifying the effects of economic and financial conditions on debt-at-risk. Furthermore, empirical estimates indicate that debt-at-risk is a key variable for predicting fiscal crises.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了"债务风险"框架，使用分位数面板回归分析宏观金融和政治条件如何影响未来债务的整个分布，发现全球公共债务在严重不利情景下可能比当前预测高出约20个百分点，且债务风险是预测财政危机的关键变量。
AI.research_question: 当前宏观金融和政治条件如何影响未来公共债务的整个分布，特别是在极端不利情景下？债务风险如何随时间和国家变化，以及它如何预测财政危机？
AI.motivation: 传统债务分析通常关注预期债务水平，但忽视了债务结果的不确定性和极端风险。需要开发一个能够评估整个债务分布风险的分析框架，特别是在当前复杂多变的宏观金融和政治环境下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于分位数回归理论，扩展传统面板回归方法，考虑债务分布的整个分位数范围，特别是上尾风险。结合宏观金融理论、债务可持续性分析和危机预测理论。
AI.method: 采用分位数面板回归框架，分析当前宏观金融和政治条件对未来债务分布的影响。考虑金融条件、初始债务水平、GDP增长等变量，特别关注95分位数的极端不利情景。
AI.findings:
1. 在严重不利情景下（95分位数），全球公共债务可能比当前预测高出约20个百分点
2. 金融条件和初始债务等变量既影响预期债务水平，也影响债务不确定性
3. 债务风险的规模和来源随时间和国家变化，高初始债务会放大经济和金融条件的影响
4. 债务风险是预测财政危机的关键变量
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了"债务风险"新概念和分析框架
2. 扩展了债务可持续性分析，从关注预期水平转向考虑整个分布
3. 发展了分位数回归在宏观金融风险分析中的应用
4. 建立了债务风险与财政危机预测的理论联系
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者提供了评估极端债务风险的工具
2. 帮助识别哪些因素会放大债务风险
3. 提供了预测财政危机的实用指标
4. 支持更全面的债务管理和风险监控策略

title: Optimal Strike Distance for Daily Crypto Stragles: Theory and Empirical Analysis
affiliations: and Washington University in St. Louis

detail.title: Optimal Strike Distance for Daily Crypto Stragles: Theory and Empirical Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract: Strike selection is a central yet underexplored decision in short-dated volatility-selling strategies, particularly in cryptocurrency options markets characterized by pronounced skew, heavy tails, and jump risk. While diffusion-based benchmarks (e.g., Black-Scholes) implicitly favor at-the-money (ATM) positioning under a volatility risk premium, these assumptions are poorly aligned with the empirical return dynamics and microstructure of crypto options. Using one-day BTC short symmetric strangles as a testbed, we parameterize strike distance and evaluate realized daily PnL on Deribit data. We first map the fixed-strike performance landscape and show that both risk-adjusted performance and left-tail outcomes are non-monotone in 𝑥 the hindsight-optimal constant distance is approximately 3% OTM, implying systematic departures from the ATM benchmark. We then formulate strike selection as a state-dependent decision problem and learn policies using three implementable approaches: direct classification, smoothed-label classification, and PnL-surface regression under a rolling out-ofsample design. All adaptive rules outperform ATM in cumulative profitability and stability diagnostics (rolling hit rate, volatility, Sharpe, and mean PnL), with temporal smoothing delivering the most robust risk-adjusted improvements. Overall, the results support state-aware strike policies over static heuristics for deployable short-dated crypto option strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了加密货币期权市场中短期波动率卖出策略的敲定价选择问题，发现基于状态的动态敲定价策略优于传统的平价基准，特别是3%虚值距离在风险调整后表现最佳。
AI.research_question: 在具有明显偏度、厚尾和跳跃风险的加密货币期权市场中，短期波动率卖出策略应如何选择最优敲定价？
AI.motivation: 传统基于扩散模型的基准（如Black-Scholes）隐含地偏好平价定位，但这些假设与加密货币期权的经验收益动态和微观结构不匹配，导致敲定价选择这一核心决策被忽视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 波动率风险溢价理论、期权定价理论、风险管理理论、状态依赖决策理论
AI.method: 使用Deribit的BTC期权数据，以一日期对称跨式期权为测试平台，参数化敲定价距离并评估每日实现盈亏。首先绘制固定敲定价表现图，然后采用三种可实施方法学习状态依赖策略：直接分类、平滑标签分类、滚动样本外设计下的盈亏曲面回归。
AI.findings: 1) 风险调整后表现和左尾结果在敲定价距离上呈非单调性，事后最优恒定距离约为3%虚值；2) 所有自适应规则在累计盈利和稳定性指标（滚动命中率、波动率、夏普比率、平均盈亏）上均优于平价基准；3) 时间平滑方法提供最稳健的风险调整改进。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 挑战了传统扩散模型在加密货币期权市场的适用性；2) 建立了状态依赖敲定价选择的理论框架；3) 提供了加密货币期权市场波动率风险溢价的新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为加密货币期权交易者提供了具体的敲定价选择策略；2) 证明了3%虚值距离的优越性；3) 开发了三种可实施的动态敲定价选择方法；4) 提高了短期波动率卖出策略的风险调整后收益。

title: Have Financial Markets become more Liquid?
affiliations: Macquarie University, University of Utah - David Eccles School of Business and University of Edinburgh

detail.title: Have Financial Markets become more Liquid?
detail.abstract: We show that while average transaction costs have fallen dramatically in U.S. equity markets, distribution of liquidity has become increasingly asymmetric. Using intraday data from 1996-2022, we document that bid-ask spread skewness has risen even as mean spreads declined. Exploiting the NYSE American speed bump and the SEC Tick Size Pilot's trade-at rule, we find that highfrequency trading increases, whereas dark trading decreases, spread skewness. Spread skewness is priced in the cross-section of returns (monthly premium of 22 bps) for Nasdaq stocks. Therefore, the combined illiquidity premium from mean and skewness remains relatively flat over time for Nasdaq.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现，尽管美国股市的平均交易成本大幅下降，但流动性的分布变得越来越不对称。1996-2022年的日内数据显示，买卖价差偏度上升，而平均价差下降。高频交易增加价差偏度，暗池交易减少价差偏度。价差偏度在纳斯达克股票的横截面回报中被定价（月溢价22个基点）。
AI.research_question: 美国股市流动性分布如何随时间变化？买卖价差偏度如何影响股票回报？高频交易和暗池交易对价差偏度有何影响？
AI.motivation: 虽然平均交易成本显著下降，但流动性的分布特征可能发生变化，特别是价差的偏度（不对称性）。这种不对称性可能对投资者产生重要影响，需要研究其决定因素和定价效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 流动性理论、市场微观结构理论、资产定价理论、高频交易影响、暗池交易效应
AI.method: 使用1996-2022年日内数据，分析买卖价差偏度的变化趋势。利用NYSE American速度缓冲和SEC Tick Size Pilot的交易规则作为准自然实验，识别高频交易和暗池交易对价差偏度的影响。通过横截面回归分析价差偏度的定价效应。
AI.findings: 1. 买卖价差偏度上升，而平均价差下降；2. 高频交易增加价差偏度，暗池交易减少价差偏度；3. 价差偏度在纳斯达克股票中被定价，月溢价22个基点；4. 纳斯达克股票的平均非流动性和偏度非流动性溢价之和相对稳定。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统研究买卖价差偏度的长期趋势；2. 识别高频交易和暗池交易对流动性分布不对称性的异质性影响；3. 将价差偏度纳入资产定价框架，扩展流动性溢价理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者提供流动性风险管理的参考；2. 为监管机构理解市场结构变化对流动性分布的影响提供证据；3. 帮助市场参与者评估不同交易场所的流动性特征。

title: Decoupling Jurisdiction from Sovereignty
affiliations: Catholic University of America (CUA) - Columbus School of Law

detail.title: Decoupling Jurisdiction from Sovereignty
detail.abstract:
Mars is a legal vacuum, literally and figuratively. With human settlement anticipated within our lifetime, the Red Planet lacks any governing legal framework despite being accessible to multiple nations with Mars-capable technology. Three countries have already landed on Mars, while others are operating satellites in Martian orbit. Conflicts over use, access, and innovation are not speculative; they are imminent. 

The current legal void is not hypothetical. It exists today and grows more dangerous with each technological advance. NASA has patented dust removal systems specifically for Martian solar panels. Goodyear developed superelastic tires engineered for Mars' extreme terrain. Boeing patented latency-reduction methods allowing for increased control of Martian rovers. Yet these Mars-specific innovations enjoy no enforceable protection on their intended planet of use. 

The law must go to Mars, and patent law offers a foundation for initiating Martian legal governance. As a purely economic framework focused on innovation incentives, patent law transcends political ideologies while serving clear public purposes. Yet current intellectual property regimes are inherently domestic and fail to account for innovations purpose-built for space. Extending American patent law to Mars would set a precedent for a broader extraterrestrial rule of law. This is not merely about intellectual property. It is a first, necessary step in building the rule of law in space.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨火星法律真空问题，提出以专利法作为建立火星法律治理的基础框架，认为这是构建太空法治的必要第一步。
AI.research_question: 如何为火星建立有效的法律治理框架，特别是针对火星特定创新的知识产权保护？
AI.motivation: 火星目前处于法律真空状态，随着人类定居临近，多个国家已具备火星探测能力，火星特定创新（如NASA的除尘系统、Goodyear的火星轮胎）缺乏可执行的法律保护，冲突风险日益增加。
AI.theoretical_framework: 专利法理论（作为纯粹的经济框架，超越政治意识形态，服务于明确的公共目的）；太空治理理论；知识产权法的地域性限制。
AI.method: 概念分析、法律框架比较、案例研究（NASA、Goodyear、Boeing的火星特定专利）。
AI.findings: 当前知识产权制度本质上是国内性的，无法适用于为太空设计的创新；将美国专利法延伸至火星可为更广泛的太空法治开创先例。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出以专利法作为建立火星法律治理的基础框架；论证专利法作为纯粹经济框架在超越政治意识形态方面的优势；为太空法治理论发展提供新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为火星特定创新提供可执行的法律保护；为太空商业活动建立法律确定性；为国际太空治理合作提供具体路径；减少火星开发中的冲突风险。

title: Multi-Dimensional Matching in Market Design
affiliations: Cornell University

detail.title: Multi-Dimensional Matching in Market Design
detail.abstract: This paper proposes a computationally efficient mechanism for multidimensional matching markets where agents report preferences over object features rather than complete utility assessments. We use Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) to identify the principal direction of variation in feature space and match agents to objects along this dimension, reducing a complex multi-dimensional problem to an effectively one-dimensional problem solvable in O(N log N) time. We show that when data exhibit low effective dimensionality (σ1 ≫ σ2), our mechanism approximately maximizes Nash Social Welfare, satisfies distributional truthfulness, and achieves symmetry. We establish a novel connection between Nash Social Welfare and Geometric Distributionally Robust Optimization, providing robustness guaranties. Numerical experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves 99% optimal welfare while running three orders of magnitude faster than direct optimization. The framework applies naturally to school choice, labor markets, and course allocation, where feature-based elicitation reduces the cognitive burden on agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种计算高效的多维匹配机制，通过奇异值分解(SVD)将高维特征空间降维到主方向，将复杂多维匹配问题简化为可O(N log N)时间求解的一维问题，在数据低有效维度下近似最大化纳什社会福利，满足分布真实性，并建立纳什社会福利与几何分布鲁棒优化的新联系。
AI.research_question: 如何设计计算高效的多维匹配机制，使代理通过报告对象特征偏好而非完整效用评估，在降低认知负担的同时实现近似最优社会福利？
AI.motivation: 传统多维匹配需要代理报告完整效用函数，认知负担重且计算复杂；现实匹配问题（学校选择、劳动力市场、课程分配）中代理偏好通常具有低有效维度，为降维简化提供了机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于奇异值分解(SVD)的降维理论，纳什社会福利最大化理论，分布真实性机制设计理论，几何分布鲁棒优化理论。
AI.method: 使用SVD识别特征空间主变化方向，将多维匹配问题降维到一维主方向；设计基于特征报告的匹配机制；理论分析机制在低有效维度(σ1 ≫ σ2)下的性能保证；数值实验验证效率和效果。
AI.findings: 当数据具有低有效维度时，该机制近似最大化纳什社会福利(99%最优)，满足分布真实性，实现对称性；计算复杂度从高维指数级降低到O(N log N)，比直接优化快三个数量级；建立了纳什社会福利与几何分布鲁棒优化的新理论联系。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 建立了多维匹配中特征降维与机制设计的新框架；2) 证明了低有效维度下机制的性能保证；3) 建立了纳什社会福利与几何分布鲁棒优化的新理论联系；4) 提出了分布真实性的新概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为学校选择、劳动力市场、课程分配等实际问题提供了计算高效的匹配方案；2) 显著降低代理的认知负担(只需报告特征偏好而非完整效用)；3) 实现近乎最优的社会福利分配；4) 提供可扩展的实际应用框架。

title: What Makes a Tax Evader?
affiliations: , Universidad de la Republica - Instituto de Economía, University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) and Universidad de la Republica

detail.title: What Makes a Tax Evader?

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Why do some individuals evade taxes while others do not? We study this question using administrative tax records from Uruguay linked to a tailored survey of taxpayers. Using third-party reports, we measure individual income under-reporting as an indicator of evasion. We then examine how three factors predict who evades: social preferences (e.g., honesty measured through incentivized laboratory games), peers (e.g., the behavior of current and former coworkers), and economic factors (e.g., the marginal tax rate). We find that social preferences have little power to predict evasion, while economic factors matter more and peer behavior is the strongest predictor.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用乌拉圭的税务记录和调查数据，发现同伴行为是预测逃税的最强因素，经济因素次之，而社会偏好（如诚实度）预测能力较弱。
AI.research_question: 为什么有些人逃税而有些人不逃？哪些因素（社会偏好、同伴行为、经济因素）能预测个人逃税行为？
AI.motivation: 理解个人逃税行为的驱动因素对于设计有效的税收政策至关重要，但现有研究对哪些因素真正预测逃税行为缺乏实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为经济学理论，研究检验三类因素对逃税行为的影响：社会偏好（如诚实度）、同伴效应（社会规范）、经济理性（边际税率等）。
AI.method: 使用乌拉圭行政税务记录与定制调查数据链接，通过第三方报告测量个人收入少报作为逃税指标，采用激励性实验室游戏测量社会偏好，分析同伴（现任和前同事）行为和经济因素的影响。
AI.findings: 社会偏好（如诚实度）对预测逃税几乎没有解释力；经济因素（如边际税率）有一定预测能力；同伴行为（现任和前同事的逃税行为）是最强的预测因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了社会偏好理论在解释逃税行为中的主导地位，强调了同伴效应和社会规范在逃税决策中的关键作用，为行为经济学提供了新的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为税收政策制定者提供了重要启示：通过影响社会规范（如减少同伴逃税行为）可能比单纯提高诚实度或调整税率更有效地减少逃税。

title: “I feel like my future is in my control”: Using Self-Determination Theory to understand young people’s early experiences of the Basic Income for Care Leavers in Wales pilot
affiliations: Cardiff University, Cardiff University, Cardiff University, Cardiff University and Cardiff University

detail.title: “I feel like my future is in my control”: Using Self-Determination Theory to understand young people’s early experiences of the Basic Income for Care Leavers in Wales pilot
detail.abstract: This paper explores early experiences of young people enrolled on the basic income for care leavers in Wales pilot through self-determination theory. Forty-four young people took part in qualitative interviews in the first six months of receiving the income as part of a wider government-commissioned evaluation. Their reported experiences were analysed under the overarching aspects of self-determination theory: autonomy, competence and relatedness, with autonomy emerging as the strongest theme. The young people contrast their increased sense of autonomy to usual barriers faced by care-leavers, suggesting they felt their circumstances as a group had been recognised by the state with the income symbolising equality-based respect, thus putting them on a more even playing field with their peers. Despite these positives, it is noted that the sample may not be representative of the whole cohort and experiences may change over the course of the pilot and after the income stops.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过自我决定理论探讨威尔士护理离校者基本收入试点项目中年轻人的早期经历，发现收入增强了他们的自主性、能力感和关联感，其中自主性是最突出的主题。
AI.research_question: 基本收入试点如何影响护理离校年轻人的自主性、能力感和关联感？
AI.motivation: 了解基本收入政策对弱势群体（特别是护理离校年轻人）的心理和社会影响，为政策制定提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自我决定理论（Self-Determination Theory），重点关注自主性、能力感和关联感三个核心维度。
AI.method: 质性研究方法，对44名参与威尔士护理离校者基本收入试点项目的年轻人在前6个月进行深度访谈，作为政府委托评估的一部分。
AI.findings:
1. 自主性是最突出的主题，年轻人对比了基本收入带来的自主感与通常护理离校者面临的障碍
2. 年轻人感到国家通过收入认可了他们作为群体的处境，象征着平等尊重的体现
3. 基本收入使他们感觉与同龄人处于更公平的竞争环境中
4. 研究样本可能无法代表整个群体，且经历可能随时间变化
AI.theory_contributions: 将自我决定理论应用于基本收入政策评估，展示了经济支持如何促进弱势群体的心理需求满足，特别是自主性的提升。
AI.practical_contributions: 为基本收入政策设计提供实证支持，表明此类政策能够增强护理离校年轻人的自主感和公平感，有助于制定更有效的社会支持政策。

title: What Drives Money Competition: Comparative Advantage in Payments versus Reserves
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania - The Wharton School - Finance Department , UCL and University of Pennsylvania - The Wharton School

detail.title: What Drives Money Competition: Comparative Advantage in Payments versus Reserves
detail.abstract: We study competition between monies that provide separate payment and non-payment (e.g., storeof-value) functions. Our central insight is that payment adoption is governed not by absolute payment superiority, but by comparative advantage between payment and non-payment roles. A money that is "too good" as a store of value may circulate less as a payment instrument, even if it is technologically superior, because agents prefer to hoard it rather than spend it. The model delivers equilibria in which monies either specialize into distinct roles or coexist as payment instruments with one emerging as dominant. These mechanisms provide a unified microfoundation for classic monetary phenomena such as Gresham's law and the big problem of small change, and offer a new perspective on modern debates over stablecoins and central bank digital currencies (CBDCs). Contrary to the common view that interest-bearing digital currencies necessarily threaten bank deposits, we show that higher yields can weaken payment adoption by raising the opportunity cost of spending. As a result, traditional bank deposits may coexist with, and even retain dominance over, technologically superior digital alternatives.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了货币在支付功能和价值储存功能之间的竞争关系，发现支付采用不仅取决于绝对技术优势，更取决于支付与非支付功能之间的比较优势。价值储存功能"太好"的货币可能流通较少，因为人们更倾向于囤积而非花费。模型解释了货币专业化分工和共存现象，为格雷欣法则等经典货币现象提供了微观基础，并对稳定币和央行数字货币的现代辩论提供了新视角。
AI.research_question: 具有不同支付功能和价值储存功能的货币之间如何竞争？支付采用的决定因素是什么？为什么技术上优越的货币可能在实际流通中处于劣势？
AI.motivation: 传统货币理论往往关注货币的单一功能，而现实中货币同时承担支付和价值储存功能。现代数字货币（如稳定币、CBDCs）的出现引发了关于货币竞争的新问题：为什么技术上优越的数字货币不一定能取代传统货币？这需要一个新的理论框架来解释货币在多重功能间的竞争关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于比较优势理论，将货币视为同时提供支付服务和价值储存服务的资产。支付采用不仅取决于绝对技术优势，更取决于支付功能相对于价值储存功能的比较优势。建立了货币竞争的双重功能模型，其中代理人在持有货币（价值储存）和花费货币（支付）之间做出权衡。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建一个货币竞争的理论模型，分析具有不同支付效率（交易成本）和储存价值（收益率）特征的货币之间的竞争均衡。模型考虑了代理人在货币持有和花费之间的最优决策，推导出货币专业化分工和共存的条件。
AI.findings: 1. 支付采用由比较优势而非绝对优势决定；2. 价值储存功能"太好"的货币（如高收益率）可能流通较少，因为机会成本高；3. 存在货币专业化均衡（一种货币主要作为支付工具，另一种作为价值储存工具）；4. 也存在货币共存均衡，其中一种货币在支付中占主导；5. 传统银行存款可能在与技术优越的数字货币竞争中保持主导地位。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为货币竞争提供了新的理论框架，强调比较优势而非绝对优势；2. 为格雷欣法则和"小额货币问题"等经典货币现象提供了统一的微观基础；3. 解释了为什么技术上优越的货币不一定能成为主要支付工具；4. 对现代数字货币辩论提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 对央行数字货币设计有重要启示：高收益率可能削弱支付采用；2. 挑战了"计息数字货币必然威胁银行存款"的常见观点；3. 为监管机构评估数字货币竞争影响提供了分析框架；4. 帮助理解传统金融体系在数字时代的韧性。

title: Managing climate financial risk in Chinese stock market: analyzing climate financial risk portfolio and policy effectiveness
affiliations: Harvard University, Department of Economics and Peking University - HSBC School of Business

detail.title: Managing climate financial risk in Chinese stock market: analyzing climate financial risk portfolio and policy effectiveness

declarations.ethicsApproval: No interest conflict

detail.abstract: This research aims to construct an optimal  climate financial risk portfolio for stock capital market investors and issuers,  regulators and policy makers to enhance performance on climate risk management and sustainable capital market regulation aligning with China’s carbon peak target by 2030 and carbon neutrality target by 2060, support SDG10.5 securities regulation for more resilient sustainable financial system, implementing the UN SDGs and Net-zero transition of Paris climate agreement in China. This research internalizes climate risk environmental externalities cost into Chinese stock capital market, creating evidence-based policy analysis, input-output value addition, stranded fossil fuel assets and carbon pricing modeling-based quantitative analysis, as well as  multi-dimensional climate damage function models based on climate stress test with spatial data and historical meteorological data. This research employs Bayesian methods to construct an optimal climate financial risk portfolio, using distributional impact and cost-benefit methodologies to explore climate physical and transition risk transmission channel in Chinese stock market, tests TCFD model for climate risk data disclosure, quantifies climate financial  risk and stock capital market  price volatility by using carbon shadow price, social cost of carbon, marginal abatement cost and stranded fuel assets, crafting carbon-induced cost function and benefit function for sciences-base carbon budget scenarios building.

AI.tldr: 本研究旨在构建最优气候金融风险投资组合，通过将气候风险环境外部性成本内化到中国股票资本市场，采用贝叶斯方法、分布影响和成本效益分析，量化气候金融风险，支持中国2030碳达峰和2060碳中和目标。
AI.research_question: 如何为中国股票资本市场投资者、发行人、监管者和政策制定者构建最优气候金融风险投资组合，以提升气候风险管理绩效并支持可持续发展目标？
AI.motivation: 中国承诺2030年碳达峰和2060年碳中和目标，需要将气候风险环境外部性成本内化到资本市场，支持SDG10.5证券监管，实现巴黎气候协定的净零转型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 气候金融风险理论、环境外部性内化理论、TCFD气候风险披露框架、碳定价理论（影子价格、社会碳成本、边际减排成本）、资产搁浅理论。
AI.method: 采用贝叶斯方法构建最优投资组合，使用分布影响和成本效益分析方法，结合基于证据的政策分析、投入产出增值分析、化石燃料资产搁浅和碳定价建模，以及基于气候压力测试的多维气候损害函数模型。
AI.findings: 通过量化气候物理风险和转型风险在中国股票市场的传导渠道，测试TCFD气候风险数据披露模型，使用碳影子价格、社会碳成本、边际减排成本和搁浅燃料资产量化气候金融风险和股票市场价格波动。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了气候风险内化到资本市场的理论框架，完善了气候金融风险投资组合构建方法，推进了TCFD模型在中国市场的应用验证。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和发行人提供气候风险优化投资组合工具，为监管者提供基于科学的碳预算情景和政策分析，支持中国双碳目标和可持续金融体系建设。

title: Liberealism: Mark Carney's New World Order

detail.title: Liberealism: Mark Carney's New World Order
detail.abstract: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney’s epochal speech at the 2026 World Economic Forum Annual Meeting in Davos has set the globe on fire. In particular, Carney’s speech was notable in that it indirectly rebuked U.S. President Donald Trump and called out “American hegemony” for hypocritically creating exemptions for itself in the “international rules-based order,” in ways that harmed allies and rivals alike. Besides, while Carney’s speech was not unprecedented in its attempt to thread the needle between the liberalism and realism in international relations theory, the speech was notable in that it articulated an approach for “middle powers” to collectively defend their interests in a realist world without having to bend to the whims of the superpowers or abandon the system of “economic integration” that has given way to “great power rivalry.” Insofar as Carney blends the worldview of realism with the toolkit of liberalism to form an action plan for middle powers, the "Carney consensus" could also be understood as "liberealism," or "middle power realism." This article attempts to explore the implications of Carney's "liberealism" for Canada, the EU, and India, while proposing a "middle power alliance" of seven cross-regional nations to complement out the G7 and the G20.

AI.tldr: 加拿大总理马克·卡尼在2026年达沃斯世界经济论坛的演讲提出了"自由现实主义"（liberealism）或"中等强国现实主义"的概念，旨在为中等强国在现实主义世界中捍卫自身利益提供行动方案，同时不屈服于超级大国的意志或放弃经济一体化体系。
AI.research_question: 卡尼的"自由现实主义"对加拿大、欧盟和印度有何影响？如何构建一个跨区域的七国"中等强国联盟"来补充G7和G20？
AI.motivation: 美国霸权在国际规则体系中为自己创造例外，损害了盟友和对手的利益。中等强国需要在现实主义世界中找到既能捍卫自身利益，又不屈服于超级大国意志或放弃经济一体化体系的路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际关系理论中的自由主义与现实主义，特别是两者的结合形成"自由现实主义"或"中等强国现实主义"。
AI.method: 理论分析结合案例研究，探讨卡尼演讲的理论内涵及其对加拿大、欧盟和印度的政策影响，并提出中等强国联盟的构想。
AI.findings: 卡尼的"自由现实主义"为中等强国提供了在现实主义世界中集体行动的理论框架，通过结合现实主义世界观和自由主义工具包，形成可行的行动方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"自由现实主义"（liberealism）或"中等强国现实主义"的新理论框架，填补了国际关系理论中中等强国行动理论的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为加拿大、欧盟和印度等中等强国提供了具体的政策指导，并提出了一个跨区域的七国"中等强国联盟"构想，作为G7和G20的补充机制。

title: Vulnerabilities of Child Labor  Migrants at the Destination in Ethiopia:The case of Sekela District
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Vulnerabilities of Child Labor  Migrants at the Destination in Ethiopia:The case of Sekela District
detail.abstract: Migrant child laborers in vulnerable situations often face significant barriers to effectively enjoy their human rights which increases their risk of violations and abuse. This manuscript examined how inter-rural child labor migrants from Sekela district face multiple risks at their destinations. Mixed methods research design was employed for the study. The primary quantitative data was collected from randomly selected 204 respondents engaged in child labor migration. Focus group discussion, informal conversational interviews, and observation were also undertaken to gather qualitative data. The findings revealed that inter-rural child labor migrants who made their journey to commercial farming sites in Ethiopia were exposed to different vulnerabilities   such as employment risk, crime, market risk, health risk, and crop failure risk. The type and degree of their vulnerability varies with their type of primary occupation at the destination. While full time wage laborers were mostly affected by poor food provision, and bad shelter, casual daily laborers overrated employment related risk such as breaching of agreement including non-payment. Market inaccessibility, climate related risks and crime were most reported risks encountered by own crop farming child laborers.  In other words, their vulnerability to challenges was impacted by contextual factors and risk management strategies of the child labor migrants themselves. These findings also underscored that their individual capacity for resilience, and their gender affect their exposure to exploitative or abusive circumstances.  While safeguarding migrant children is crucial, it is equally vital to empower them to protect themselves, especially in peripheral rural farmland area contexts where protection is lacking.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨埃塞俄比亚Sekela地区农村间童工移民在商业农场面临的多种风险，发现其脆弱性因职业类型而异，受个人韧性、性别和风险应对策略影响。
AI.research_question: 埃塞俄比亚Sekela地区农村间童工移民在目的地面临哪些风险？这些风险如何因职业类型和个人因素而异？
AI.motivation: 弱势移民童工面临人权障碍和虐待风险增加，需要了解他们在商业农场环境中的具体脆弱性，以制定有效保护措施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 脆弱性理论、风险暴露框架、儿童保护理论、移民研究中的性别视角
AI.method: 混合方法研究设计：定量数据来自204名随机选择的童工移民；定性数据通过焦点小组讨论、非正式访谈和观察收集
AI.findings: 童工移民面临就业风险、犯罪、市场风险、健康风险和作物歉收风险；脆弱性因职业类型而异：全职工资工受食物和住所问题影响最大；临时日工面临协议违约和欠薪风险；自耕农童工主要遭遇市场准入、气候相关风险和犯罪问题
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了移民童工脆弱性理论，强调职业类型对风险暴露的影响，提出情境因素和个人风险应对策略的交互作用框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供针对不同职业类型童工的风险干预策略，强调在缺乏保护的农村地区需要同时加强制度保护和提升儿童自我保护能力

title: Amicus Brief Superficially in Support of Thaler’s Petition for Certiorari (Which I Guess I’m Not Going to File Now)
affiliations: University of Kentucky - J. David Rosenberg College of Law

detail.title: Amicus Brief Superficially in Support of Thaler’s Petition for Certiorari (Which I Guess I’m Not Going to File Now)
detail.abstract:
This is an essay styled as an amicus brief in support of Dr. Richard L. Thaler’s petition for certiorari in Thaler v. Perlmutter. Thaler used a generative AI model to create a digital image and filed a copyright registration application for the image as a work made for hire created by the AI model. When the Copyright Office refused to register the image, Thaler appealed all the way to the Supreme Court.

I argue that the Supreme Court should grant Thaler's petition for certiorari because the D.C. Circuit reached the right result for the wrong reason. It held that copyright doesn't protect Thaler's image because it lacks human authorship. It should have held that copyright doesn't and can't protect Thaler's image because it utterly lacks creativity. I then draw some conclusions about human authorship based on that observation.

AI.tldr: 本文以法庭之友意見書形式，支持Thaler向最高法院提出的調卷令申請，主張D.C.巡迴法院雖得出正確結論但理由錯誤：應以作品缺乏創造性而非缺乏人類作者身份為由拒絕AI生成圖像的版權保護。
AI.research_question: AI生成內容是否應受版權保護？法院應以何種法律標準來評估AI生成作品的版權適格性？
AI.motivation: Thaler使用生成式AI模型創作數字圖像並申請版權註冊，但版權局拒絕註冊，案件上訴至最高法院。作者認為巡迴法院雖得出正確結論但理由錯誤，需要澄清AI生成內容版權保護的法律標準。
AI.theoretical_framework: 版權法理論、作者身份理論、創造性標準、AI生成內容的法律地位、著作權適格性理論
AI.method: 法律分析、案例研究、論證分析、比較法分析（以法庭之友意見書形式）
AI.findings: 1. D.C.巡迴法院得出正確結論（AI生成圖像不應受版權保護）但理由錯誤；2. 應以作品缺乏創造性而非缺乏人類作者身份為由拒絕保護；3. AI生成內容因缺乏真正的創造性而不符合版權保護標準；4. 人類作者身份應基於創造性貢獻而非單純的技術操作。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 澄清AI生成內容版權保護的法律標準；2. 區分人類作者身份與創造性標準；3. 提出以創造性而非作者身份作為AI生成內容版權適格性的核心標準；4. 對版權法中的作者身份理論進行重新審視。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 為最高法院審理Thaler案提供法律論證支持；2. 為AI生成內容的版權保護問題提供明確的法律標準；3. 幫助法院在處理類似案件時採用正確的法律推理；4. 為版權局處理AI生成內容註冊申請提供指導原則。

title: What Companies Say vs. What Matters: LLM Analysis of Biodiversity Disclosures in Oil and Gas
affiliations: University of Illinois Chicago,  and University of Illinois at Chicago - College of Business Administration

detail.title: What Companies Say vs. What Matters: LLM Analysis of Biodiversity Disclosures in Oil and Gas
detail.abstract:
The power system ecosystem encompasses infrastructure intensive industries such as electric utilities, hydropower operators, oil and gas producers, and mining companies supplying critical minerals. These industries share a common challenge: their physical assets interact extensively with natural ecosystems, creating dependencies and impacts that increasingly draw investor and stakeholder scrutiny. Many companies voluntarily disclose nature related commitments through platforms like the Carbon Disclosure Project (CDP), often in response to investor and stakeholder pressure. Yet little is known about whether these disclosures reflect substantive, measurable targets aligned with companies' most material impacts. As nature related financial risks gain attention from investors and lenders, understanding the quality of these commitments becomes critical for capital allocation and policy design.

This paper develops a large language model (LLM) methodology to analyze corporate biodiversity disclosures across infrastructure intensive industries within the power system ecosystem. We demonstrate the approach using oil and gas producers in the United States as a test case, classifying CDP questionnaire responses as goals, commitments, or SMART targets (specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound) and assessing their alignment with Global Biodiversity Framework categories and  Exploring Natural Capital Opportunities, Risks and Exposure (ENCORE) identified material impacts and dependencies. Our analysis reveals that what companies say is often disconnected from what matters: disclosures are specific but lack measurability and time bound elements, with firms focusing on governance and data related categories rather than their most material ecosystem impacts. Yet peer patterns offer guidance: co-occurrence in disclosure categories reveals common practices that provide roadmaps for companies beginning their target setting journey. These findings point to two paths forward: companies can fill gaps by learning from peers which high materiality areas to prioritize, and can find the right words by using LLMs to articulate their existing actions in alignment with biodiversity frameworks rather than necessarily doing more.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一种基于大语言模型的方法，分析电力系统生态系统中基础设施密集型企业的生物多样性披露质量。以美国油气生产商为案例，发现企业披露内容往往与实质性影响脱节：虽然具体但缺乏可衡量性和时限性，且关注治理和数据而非实质性生态系统影响。同行模式为改善披露提供了指导。
AI.research_question: 企业自愿披露的生物多样性承诺是否反映了与其最实质性影响相一致的、可衡量的目标？
AI.motivation: 电力系统生态系统中的基础设施密集型企业（如电力公司、水电运营商、油气生产商、矿业公司）与自然生态系统存在广泛互动，其依赖和影响日益受到投资者和利益相关者关注。虽然许多企业通过CDP等平台自愿披露自然相关承诺，但这些披露是否反映实质性、可衡量的目标尚不清楚。随着自然相关金融风险受到关注，理解这些承诺的质量对资本配置和政策设计至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 企业环境披露理论；2. 生物多样性框架（全球生物多样性框架）；3. 实质性影响评估（ENCORE框架）；4. SMART目标设定原则；5. 同行效应与制度理论
AI.method: 开发基于大语言模型的方法论，分析企业生物多样性披露。以美国油气生产商为测试案例，对CDP问卷回答进行分类：目标、承诺或SMART目标（具体、可衡量、可实现、相关、有时限）。评估这些披露与全球生物多样性框架类别及ENCORE识别的实质性影响和依赖的匹配度。
AI.findings: 1. 企业披露内容与实质性影响脱节：披露具体但缺乏可衡量性和时限性要素；2. 企业关注治理和数据相关类别，而非最实质性的生态系统影响；3. 同行模式提供指导：披露类别的共现揭示了常见实践，为企业目标设定提供路线图。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 开发了基于LLM的企业生物多样性披露分析方法论；2. 揭示了企业环境披露中"言行不一"的现象；3. 扩展了企业环境披露质量评估的理论框架；4. 为制度理论在环境披露领域的应用提供新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业提供两条改进路径：向同行学习优先处理高实质性领域；使用LLM将现有行动与生物多样性框架对齐；2. 为投资者提供评估企业生物多样性承诺质量的工具；3. 为政策制定者设计自然相关金融风险监管提供依据；4. 为CDP等披露平台改进问卷设计提供参考。

title: Private Equity, Public Utility
affiliations: California Western School of Law and Lewis & Clark Law School

detail.title: Private Equity, Public Utility
detail.abstract:
The explosion of investment in artificial intelligence and cryptocurrencies has spurred a data center boom, with politicians jostling to attract companies to build data centers in their states. The potential financial windfall from these data centers has also attracted the attention of private equity firms, which are seeking to capitalize on the potential riches to be made in supplying these projects with electricity by buying regulated public electric utilities. These utilities are unusual in our capitalist system, in that they are subject to both state and federal regulation regarding their duties to serve the public and the amount they can charge for their services. Public utilities have only one source of revenue: their customers. But when a utility is purchased by a private equity company, it becomes one of a portfolio of businesses that the company expects will generate a return on its investment.

History has shown that companies that own public utilities in portfolios manipulate filings and finances to maximize profits at the expense of the utilities’ captive customers. When private equity firms, which have no purpose other than to realize the highest possible returns for investors, become owners of public utilities, the risks to ratepayers skyrocket.  This paper is the first to identify this emerging phenomenon and advocate for halting or placing strict conditions on these acquisitions. We do this by showing how investment companies may be able to take advantage of two flawed regulatory systems—the system that regulates utilities and the system that regulates corporations and private investment firms—to extract value from utilities while shifting risks onto ratepayers and society at large.

AI.tldr: 私募股权公司收购受监管的公共电力公司，利用监管漏洞从公用事业中榨取价值，将风险转嫁给用户和社会，需要停止或严格限制此类收购。
AI.research_question: 私募股权公司收购受监管的公共电力公司如何利用监管漏洞榨取价值并转嫁风险给用户？
AI.motivation: AI和加密货币投资热潮推动数据中心建设，私募股权公司为获取电力供应利润而收购受监管的公共电力公司，但历史表明这会损害用户利益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管套利理论、公用事业监管理论、公司治理理论、私募股权投资行为理论
AI.method: 理论分析、监管制度分析、历史案例研究、系统性风险识别
AI.findings: 私募股权公司可利用公用事业监管和公司监管两个有缺陷的监管系统之间的漏洞，从公用事业中榨取价值，同时将风险转嫁给用户和社会。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次识别私募股权收购公共电力公司的新兴现象，提出监管套利在公用事业领域的应用框架，拓展了公用事业监管理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 呼吁停止或严格限制私募股权对公共电力公司的收购，提出加强监管的政策建议，保护用户免受不公平风险转移。

title: Morris, Feminist Legal Studies (forthcoming) 1 Should Women Claim Mars? An Interplanetary Theory of Collective Reparations

detail.title: Morris, Feminist Legal Studies (forthcoming) 1 Should Women Claim Mars? An Interplanetary Theory of Collective Reparations
detail.abstract: This article extends the moral, political, and legal argument for reparations beyond Earth. In a world where the whole Earth could be promised to different beneficiaries of historical injustice many times over, this article asks: what might gender-transformative reparations require? Focusing on the gendered harms and structures of responsibility and power in the era of fossil fuels, I use the idea of women collectively claiming Mars as a critical utopian lens for examining what reparative justice might demand from a feminist perspective in the face of Earth's destruction. Drawing on legal and philosophical scholarship, this article outlines the groundwork for an interplanetary feminist reparations theory.

AI.tldr: 本文将赔偿的道德、政治和法律论证扩展到地球之外，探讨在面临地球毁灭时，从女权主义视角看赔偿正义可能要求什么，特别关注化石燃料时代的性别伤害以及责任和权力结构。
AI.research_question: 从女权主义视角出发，在面临地球毁灭的情况下，赔偿正义可能要求什么？
AI.motivation: 在一个整个地球可能被多次承诺给历史不公正的不同受益者的世界里，需要探索超越地球的赔偿理论，特别关注化石燃料时代对女性的伤害。
AI.theoretical_framework: 女权主义赔偿理论、批判乌托邦理论、行星际赔偿理论、法律和哲学赔偿理论
AI.method: 理论分析、批判性乌托邦思考、法律和哲学文献分析，使用"女性集体主张火星"作为分析透镜
AI.findings: 提出了行星际女权主义赔偿理论的基础框架，强调需要超越地球的赔偿视角，关注性别伤害和权力结构的转变
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了赔偿理论到地球之外，发展了行星际女权主义赔偿理论，为赔偿正义提供了新的批判乌托邦视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为面对地球毁灭时的赔偿实践提供了女权主义框架，为性别变革性赔偿政策提供了理论基础

title: Public Development and the Promise of Social Housing: Assessing New Government-Led Housing Models in the U.S.
affiliations: New York University,  and

detail.title: Public Development and the Promise of Social Housing: Assessing New Government-Led Housing Models in the U.S.
detail.abstract:
Amid a national housing crisis, and running counter to a decades-long shift towards increasing reliance on the private market to produce affordable housing, government agencies at the state and local levels are revisiting their own capacity to directly develop and own housing. These public development initiatives vary widely in their approach to development, with differences in the degree and type of agency involvement and the public inputs and financing tools used. They also differ in the kinds of housing they produce, in terms of scale, amenities, affordability, and income mix; the level of insulation from market forces through regulations, public ownership, or other means; and the degree of resident engagement and control. As such, these models also vary in how well they map onto the concept of “social housing,” which commonly refers to publicly or collectively owned housing that removes housing from the speculative market and fosters resident engagement and social integration. Above all, social housing emphasizes the role of housing as a place to live, rather than a vehicle for investment.

In this paper, we draw on in-depth interviews with practitioners to better understand the emerging strategies for publicly developing housing in the United States and examine the degree to which the housing they produce (or expect to produce) meets key criteria for social housing. Case studies of initiatives in Montgomery County, MD; Atlanta, GA; Chicago, IL; Colorado; Boston, MA; Cambridge, MA; Dakota County, MN; and Idaho elucidate the potential advantages and drawbacks of different approaches. Our findings can inform localities weighing where, how, and what type of housing to produce, as well as policies at the state and federal levels that could bolster or expand on local efforts.

AI.tldr: 本文通过深度访谈和案例研究，分析了美国州和地方层面重新发展公共住房的新兴策略，探讨这些公共开发项目在多大程度上符合"社会住房"的关键标准。
AI.research_question: 美国州和地方层面的公共住房开发策略如何？这些策略产生的住房在多大程度上符合社会住房的关键标准？
AI.motivation: 在全国住房危机的背景下，政府机构重新审视自身直接开发和拥有住房的能力，这与几十年来日益依赖私人市场提供经济适用房的趋势背道而驰。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会住房理论框架：强调住房作为居住场所而非投资工具，要求公共或集体所有权、脱离投机市场、促进居民参与和社会融合。
AI.method: 深度访谈从业者，案例研究包括马里兰州蒙哥马利县、佐治亚州亚特兰大、伊利诺伊州芝加哥、科罗拉多州、马萨诸塞州波士顿、马萨诸塞州剑桥、明尼苏达州达科他县和爱达荷州等地的公共住房倡议。
AI.findings: 不同公共开发模式在机构参与程度、融资工具、住房规模、配套设施、可负担性、收入混合、市场隔离程度以及居民参与控制等方面存在显著差异，这些差异决定了它们与社会住房标准的契合程度。
AI.theory_contributions: 为社会住房理论提供了美国本土化的实证分析，明确了不同公共开发模式与社会住房核心原则的对应关系，丰富了住房政策理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为地方政府权衡住房生产的地点、方式和类型提供参考，为州和联邦层面的政策制定提供依据，支持或扩展地方住房开发努力。

title: How to Tax the Ultrarich

detail.title: How to Tax the Ultrarich

declarations.funderStatement: This project was supported by the Roosevelt Institute, https://rooseveltinstitute.org/.

detail.abstract:
This report proposes a new tax, the Fair Share Tax (FAST), on very wealthy households. The FAST is imposed at sale like the current capital gains tax, but adds an interest-like extra tax on taxpayers who hold their assets for long periods. It therefore mimics the cash flows and economic incentives of a “mark-to-market” capital gains tax with a $15 million lifetime exclusion amount. Because it is collected at sale, the FAST is fully consistent with any possible constitutional limits that might rule out annual wealth or mark-to-market taxes. In addition, the FAST replaces the estate and gift tax system with an extra tax bracket for inherited property, in effect switching to an inheritance tax and carryover basis at death, but again with extra interest charges for taxpayers who delay sale. 

The report also explores the economic, legal, and political rationale for the FAST and offers detailed descriptions of the legal rules needed to fit that rationale. Most importantly, it argues that US holders of vast wealth today enjoy opportunities to control social and political outcomes without spending their accumulated wealth. These facts make reforms to more effectively tax the ultrarich fairly urgent and imply that alternatives such as a value-added tax or other consumption tax would be ineffective at that goal.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"公平份额税"(FAST)，对极富裕家庭征收新型资本利得税，在出售时征税但包含类似利息的额外税款，模仿市值计价税制，同时改革遗产税体系。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种既符合宪法限制又能有效对极富裕家庭征税的新型税收制度？
AI.motivation: 当前极富裕家庭通过持有资产长期不售来规避资本利得税，且能控制社会政治结果而不动用财富，现有税制无法有效征税，改革迫在眉睫。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合资本利得税、市值计价税、遗产税理论，设计在出售时征税但包含时间价值补偿的混合税制。
AI.method: 规范性政策分析，探讨FAST的经济、法律和政治理论基础，并提供详细法律规则设计。
AI.findings: FAST能模仿市值计价税的经济激励，同时避免宪法问题；改革遗产税为继承税加递延销售利息；增值税等消费税无法有效对极富裕家庭征税。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出新型混合税制理论框架，解决市值计价税宪法限制问题；整合资本利得税与遗产税改革；论证时间价值补偿在税制设计中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供具体可操作的FAST实施方案；为政策制定者提供符合宪法的新型财富税设计；指出消费税改革对解决极富裕家庭征税问题的局限性。

title: Upgrading to Escape the Low Value-Added Trap in Global Value Chains: The Mediating Role of Strategic Learning Capability

detail.title: Upgrading to Escape the Low Value-Added Trap in Global Value Chains: The Mediating Role of Strategic Learning Capability
detail.abstract: Combining both internalizing and externalizing logics in governance has been argued to enhance the efficiency of global value chain (GVCs); however, its implication for suppliers' upgrading remains contested. The fragmentation of value chain activities has increased interdependencies between multinational enterprises (MNEs) and suppliers in developing economy that can be managed through effective governance strategies. While previous studies often claim that MNEs' governance strategies determine suppliers' upgrading potential in GVCs, the findings have been inconclusive, prompting calls for more research on this relationship. In this study, we draw from resource dependence and relational exchange theories to explore how buyer-supplier relationships manage external dependencies in GVCs, and the implications of these dependencies for supplier upgrading and performance. We argue that socially embedded relational governance when interacting with relationship length facilitates strategic learning capability, which in turn influences both low and high value-added upgrading of suppliers as well as their performance. Our findings reveal that strategic learning capability serves as the mechanism through which the benefits of a socially embedded relational governance are transformed into suppliers' upgrading. Moreover, high value-added upgrading has a stronger impact on suppliers' performance than low value-added upgrading. These findings suggest that strategies for managing external dependencies are influenced not solely by external and internal factors but rather their interaction. We draw implications of these findings for research and practice.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了全球价值链中买方-供应商关系如何通过战略学习能力影响供应商升级和绩效。研究发现，社会嵌入型关系治理与关系持续时间的交互作用通过战略学习能力促进供应商升级，其中高附加值升级对供应商绩效的影响更强。
AI.research_question: 全球价值链中，买方-供应商关系如何管理外部依赖，以及这些依赖如何影响供应商升级和绩效？
AI.motivation: 虽然内化和外化治理逻辑的结合被认为能提高全球价值链效率，但其对供应商升级的影响存在争议。跨国公司治理策略决定供应商升级潜力的观点缺乏一致结论，需要更多研究探索这一关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资源依赖理论和关系交换理论，用于解释买方-供应商关系如何管理全球价值链中的外部依赖。
AI.method: 未在摘要中明确说明，但基于理论框架构建研究模型，探讨变量间的机制关系。
AI.findings: 1. 战略学习能力是社会嵌入型关系治理转化为供应商升级的中介机制；2. 高附加值升级比低附加值升级对供应商绩效的影响更强；3. 管理外部依赖的策略不仅受外部和内部因素单独影响，更受其交互作用影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 整合资源依赖和关系交换理论解释全球价值链治理；2. 识别战略学习能力作为关键中介机制；3. 区分高低附加值升级的不同影响；4. 强调因素交互作用而非单独影响的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为供应商提供通过关系治理和战略学习实现升级的路径；2. 帮助跨国公司设计更有效的供应商治理策略；3. 强调长期关系和社会嵌入对知识转移的重要性；4. 指导供应商优先发展高附加值升级能力。

title: Tourism Carrying Capacity as Dynamic Property of Complex Socio-Ecological Systems
affiliations: Fondazione Eni Enrico Mattei (FEEM), Venice, Fondazione Eni Enrico Mattei (FEEM) and Ca Foscari University of Venice - Dipartimento di Economia

detail.title: Tourism Carrying Capacity as Dynamic Property of Complex Socio-Ecological Systems

publicationDetails.journalName: FEEM Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Overtourism is not just overcrowding: it is a systemic imbalance sustained by feedbacks between visitors, residents’ welfare, the performance of local facilities, and environmental quality. Tourism carrying capacity sits at the centre of overtourism research and policy, yet it is still commonly operationalised as static visitor limits, implicitly assuming that thresholds could be set without accounting for the feedbacks they are meant to regulate. Here we introduce a minimal dynamical model that retains the essential feedbacks through which residents, tourists, economic capital, and environmental quality co-evolve. From this model, a formal definition of tourism carrying capacity emerges as a state-dependent quantity shaped by economic conditions, environmental quality, and social responses, and tempered by congestion and competitive pressure. Crucially, capacity alone is a weak planning target: sustainability depends on the long-run regime selected by the coupled system, and on how that regime shifts under perturbations. A bifurcation analysis of policy-relevant parameters maps tipping points and the resulting regime structure, from stable coexistence to multistability and sustained oscillations, including overtourism outcomes where tourism and capital persist while residents and environmental quality collapse. Overall, the results clarify, in a unified and rigorous setting, why capacity thresholds may inadequately reflect the dynamic complexity of tourism systems, and how integrated dynamical analyses can inform more robust policy design.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个最小动态模型来研究过度旅游问题，将旅游承载力重新定义为受经济条件、环境质量和社会响应影响的动态量，而非静态游客限制。通过分岔分析揭示了旅游系统的多种稳定状态，包括过度旅游结果。
AI.research_question: 如何通过动态系统模型重新定义和理解旅游承载力，以更准确地反映旅游系统的复杂性并指导政策设计？
AI.motivation: 当前过度旅游研究中，旅游承载力通常被操作化为静态游客限制，这种简化方法未能考虑游客、居民福利、当地设施表现和环境质量之间的反馈机制，导致政策设计不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统动力学理论、旅游承载力理论、分岔分析理论、复杂系统理论
AI.method: 构建最小动态模型，包含居民、游客、经济资本和环境质量四个核心要素及其相互反馈机制；采用分岔分析识别政策相关参数的临界点和系统状态结构
AI.findings: 1. 旅游承载力应定义为受经济条件、环境质量和社会响应影响的动态量；2. 系统存在多种稳定状态：稳定共存、多重稳定性和持续振荡；3. 过度旅游状态下，旅游和经济资本持续存在，而居民和环境质量崩溃；4. 仅关注承载力是薄弱的规划目标，可持续性取决于耦合系统的长期状态
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了一个统一的动态模型框架，整合了旅游系统的关键反馈机制；2. 重新概念化了旅游承载力，从静态阈值转向状态依赖的动态量；3. 揭示了旅游系统的非线性动态特征和临界点行为
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了识别系统临界点和不同状态的分析工具；2. 强调了综合动态分析在旅游规划中的重要性；3. 指出了单纯依赖游客数量限制的局限性，提出了更全面的政策设计思路

reference: Bielefeld Working Papers in Economics and Management No. 02-2026
title: Capacity Expansion Investment under Financing Constraint
affiliations: Bielefeld University,  and University of Bielefeld

detail.title: Capacity Expansion Investment under Financing Constraint

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bielefeld Working Papers in Economics and Management No. 02-2026
publicationDetails.journalName: Bielefeld Working Papers in Economics & Management

detail.abstract: This research studies a monopoly firm’s timing and size decisions to introduce a new and partially substitutable product under demand uncertainty and financing constraint. Accessible financing resources for the investment are positively related to firm’s revenues from the existing product. We find the firm’s optimal investment decision is influenced by the cannibalization effect that delays investment, the revenue effect that advances investment, and the financingeffect that allows for a larger investment in case of more financing resources. In particular, the financing constraint is only binding for intermediate levels of demand uncertainty. Under the non-binding financing constraint, a larger old market revenue makes the firm invest later and less due to the dominant cannibalization effect. Under the binding financing constraint, a larger old market revenue can make the firm invest earlier and more because of the dominant revenue and financing effects. Furthermore, the socially optimal investment is more susceptible to the binding financing constraint because the investment size is larger than that maximizes firm’s profits.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨垄断企业在需求不确定性和融资约束下，引入部分替代性新产品的时机和规模决策。研究发现，投资决策受蚕食效应（延迟投资）、收入效应（提前投资）和融资效应（更多融资资源允许更大投资）的共同影响。融资约束仅在中等需求不确定性水平下具有约束力。
AI.research_question: 在需求不确定性和融资约束条件下，垄断企业如何决定引入部分替代性新产品的时机和投资规模？
AI.motivation: 企业引入新产品时面临需求不确定性和融资约束的双重挑战，现有产品收入影响融资能力，而新产品可能蚕食现有产品市场，需要研究这些因素如何共同影响投资决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于实物期权理论、融资约束理论和产品替代理论，分析蚕食效应、收入效应和融资效应对投资决策的影响机制。
AI.method: 采用动态优化模型，构建垄断企业在需求不确定性和融资约束下的投资决策框架，通过数学建模和数值分析研究最优投资时机和规模。
AI.findings: 1. 融资约束仅在中等需求不确定性水平下具有约束力；2. 无融资约束时，现有产品收入增加会因蚕食效应主导而延迟投资并减少投资规模；3. 有融资约束时，现有产品收入增加会因收入和融资效应主导而提前投资并增加投资规模；4. 社会最优投资规模大于企业利润最大化规模，更易受融资约束影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 整合了需求不确定性、融资约束和产品替代性对投资决策的影响；2. 揭示了蚕食效应、收入效应和融资效应的相互作用机制；3. 明确了融资约束的边界条件（中等不确定性水平）。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业管理者提供在融资约束下制定新产品投资策略的决策框架；2. 帮助政策制定者理解融资约束如何影响社会最优投资；3. 为金融机构评估企业新产品投资风险提供理论依据。

title: Tax Incentives, Portfolio Choice, and Macroprudential Risks
affiliations: , University of St. Gallen and University of St. Gallen

detail.title: Tax Incentives, Portfolio Choice, and Macroprudential Risks

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We calibrate a lifecycle portfolio-choice model of homeowners facing uninsurable income risk to show that tax deductions for mortgage interest payments and voluntary pension contributions have sizable effects on household portfolios and macroprudential risks. The deductions reduce the after-tax cost of debt and increase the after-tax return of pension savings so that the mortgage incidence increases and portfolios shift from home equity and liquid assets towards pension savings. Because the consumption responses to a house-price decline are heterogeneous, the distribution of household debt shapes the quantitative effect of the tax deductions on the homeowners' resilience after a house price bust.

AI.tldr: 本文通过生命周期投资组合模型分析房贷利息抵税和养老金自愿缴款税收优惠对家庭资产配置和宏观审慎风险的影响。研究发现这些税收政策会降低债务税后成本、提高养老金税后收益，导致家庭增加房贷、减少住房权益和流动资产、增加养老金储蓄。由于房价下跌时消费反应存在异质性，家庭债务分布会影响税收政策对房价崩盘后家庭韧性的定量效应。
AI.research_question: 房贷利息抵税和养老金缴款税收优惠如何影响家庭资产配置组合和宏观审慎风险？这些税收政策如何塑造家庭在房价下跌后的韧性？
AI.motivation: 许多国家实施房贷利息抵税和养老金缴款税收优惠政策，但这些政策对家庭投资组合选择和系统性风险的影响尚未得到充分研究。理解这些税收激励如何影响家庭债务积累和资产配置对于评估宏观审慎政策有效性至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于生命周期投资组合选择理论，考虑不可保收入风险、住房所有权和税收政策。模型纳入房贷利息抵税和养老金缴款税收优惠对家庭决策的影响。
AI.method: 校准生命周期投资组合选择模型，模拟房主在不可保收入风险下的决策。通过数值模拟分析税收政策对家庭资产配置、债务积累和宏观审慎风险的影响。
AI.findings: 税收抵扣降低债务税后成本、提高养老金税后收益，导致房贷发生率增加，投资组合从住房权益和流动资产转向养老金储蓄。由于消费对房价下跌的反应存在异质性，家庭债务分布显著影响税收政策对房价崩盘后家庭韧性的定量效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 将税收政策纳入生命周期投资组合选择模型，分析其对家庭资产配置和宏观审慎风险的影响。揭示税收激励如何通过改变债务成本和资产收益影响家庭决策，以及债务分布如何调节房价冲击的传导机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供评估税收政策对家庭韧性和金融稳定影响的框架。建议在设计税收激励时考虑其对债务积累和宏观审慎风险的影响，特别是在房价波动环境下。

title: Cold War on a Warming Planet: Climate Policy in a Divided World
affiliations: ETH Zürich - CER-ETH - Center of Economic Research at ETH Zurich

detail.title: Cold War on a Warming Planet: Climate Policy in a Divided World

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: The study examines economic growth and climate change when system competition between countries causes drastic changes in their climate policies. The world is divided into two groups of countries: one that implements strict climate policies and another that refrains from doing so due to concerns about the negative economic impacts. A policy tipping point occurs once the economic performance of the proactive group surpasses that of the laggards, prompting the latter to implement comparable climate measures. I find that the impact of policy tipping is significant on emissions but moderate on economic growth. The occurrence of the policy shift depends on policy design and technological progress. In a divided world, subsidies for clean energy research prove more effective than carbon pricing in accelerating global decarbonization because they induce earlier tipping. Achieving the internationally agreed climate targets requires that proactive countries combine ambitious emissions reductions with sustained economic prosperity, an outcome attainable through an efficient mix of taxes and subsidies.

AI.tldr: 研究探讨了国家间系统竞争导致气候政策剧变时的经济增长与气候变化问题。当积极实施气候政策的国家经济表现超越滞后国家时，会触发政策转折点，促使后者采取类似措施。研究发现政策转折对排放影响显著但对经济增长影响温和，政策转变取决于政策设计和科技进步。在分裂的世界中，清洁能源研发补贴比碳定价更能加速全球脱碳，因为能更早触发转折点。
AI.research_question: 当国家间系统竞争导致气候政策剧变时，政策转折点如何影响全球排放和经济增长？在分裂的世界格局下，何种政策设计能最有效地加速全球脱碳并实现气候目标？
AI.motivation: 现实世界中，国家在气候政策上存在分歧：一些国家积极实施严格气候政策，而另一些国家因担心负面经济影响而回避。这种分裂格局导致全球气候治理面临挑战，需要研究政策转折点的触发机制及其对排放和经济增长的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于系统竞争理论、政策转折点理论、以及气候政策经济学框架，分析国家间气候政策竞争如何影响全球减排路径和经济增长动态。
AI.method: 采用理论建模方法，将世界划分为两个国家群体（积极气候政策组和滞后组），分析政策转折点的触发条件，评估不同政策工具（碳定价vs研发补贴）对全球脱碳进程的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 政策转折点对全球排放有显著影响，但对经济增长影响相对温和；2. 政策转变的发生取决于政策设计和科技进步；3. 在分裂世界中，清洁能源研发补贴比碳定价更有效，因为能更早触发政策转折；4. 实现国际气候目标需要积极国家结合雄心减排与持续经济繁荣。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 发展了气候政策转折点理论，解释了国家间政策趋同的触发机制；2. 揭示了在分裂世界格局下不同政策工具的相对有效性；3. 为理解系统竞争如何影响全球气候治理提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了设计有效气候政策组合的指导（税收与补贴的优化组合）；2. 建议积极国家应同时追求减排目标和经济繁荣以触发全球政策转折；3. 强调研发补贴在加速全球脱碳中的关键作用。

title: Understanding Carbon Leakage
affiliations: University of Oldenburg and Norwegian University of Life Sciences

detail.title: Understanding Carbon Leakage

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Carbon leakage is a major concern in the design of unilateral climate policies aimed at reducing global emissions in a cost-effective manner. In order to assess the cost-effectiveness of anti-leakage measures, it is crucial to understand the fundamental mechanisms that contribute to leakage. We provide theoretical analysis of the two main channels of leakage: the fossil fuel market channel and the competitiveness channel. We show that the two channels reinforce each other. Furthermore, we find that whereas leakage via the fossil fuel market channel decreases with the fuel supply elasticity and increases with the fuel demand elasticity, the opposite is the case for the competitiveness channel. We show that the effectiveness of output-based allocation and border carbon adjustments to combat carbon leakage increases with the fuel supply elasticity and decreases with the fuel demand elasticity. We supplement the simplified theoretical analysis with numerical simulations using a more complex multi-sector, multi-region computable general equilibrium model of the global economy to quantify the implications of unilateral climate policy designs for the European Union. We find that leakage via the fossil fuel channel dominates leakage via the competitiveness channel unless fuel supply elasticities are quite high and fuel demand elasticities are quite low. Furthermore, we find that the lower the fossil fuel demand elasticity, the greater the gains in cost-effectiveness from implementing anti-leakage measures.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了单边气候政策中的碳泄漏问题，探讨了化石燃料市场渠道和竞争力渠道两种主要泄漏机制，并评估了产出分配和边境碳调整等反泄漏措施的有效性。
AI.research_question: 单边气候政策设计中的碳泄漏机制是什么？如何通过反泄漏措施提高全球减排的成本效益？
AI.motivation: 碳泄漏是单边气候政策设计中的主要关切，会影响全球减排的成本效益。理解泄漏的根本机制对于评估反泄漏措施的有效性至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 碳泄漏理论框架，包括化石燃料市场渠道和竞争力渠道两种主要泄漏机制，以及燃料供给弹性和需求弹性对泄漏的影响。
AI.method: 理论分析结合数值模拟：首先进行简化的理论分析，然后使用多部门、多区域的可计算一般均衡模型对欧盟单边气候政策设计进行量化模拟。
AI.findings: 1. 两种泄漏渠道相互强化；2. 化石燃料市场渠道的泄漏随燃料供给弹性增加而减少，随需求弹性增加而增加，竞争力渠道则相反；3. 除非燃料供给弹性很高且需求弹性很低，否则化石燃料渠道的泄漏占主导；4. 化石燃料需求弹性越低，实施反泄漏措施的成本效益增益越大。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 系统分析了碳泄漏的两种主要渠道及其相互作用机制；2. 明确了燃料供给和需求弹性对不同泄漏渠道的影响方向；3. 揭示了产出分配和边境碳调整措施有效性的弹性依赖性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者设计单边气候政策提供了理论指导；2. 量化了欧盟实施不同气候政策设计的泄漏效应；3. 提供了评估反泄漏措施成本效益的决策依据，特别是针对化石燃料需求弹性较低的情况。
