title: Left Behind Places and Regional Resilience to COVID-19 Shock in Europe
affiliations: Independent, Gran Sasso Science Institute, Università degli Studi di Milano-Bicocca - Department of Economics, Management and Statistics (DEMS) and Gran Sasso Science Institute (GSSI)

detail.title: Left Behind Places and Regional Resilience to COVID-19 Shock in Europe

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Milan Bicocca Department of Economics, Management and Statistics Working Paper No. 568
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Milan Bicocca Department of Economics, Management & Statistics Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Current turbulent times pose challenges not only for countries, but also-and above all-for regions within them. However, economic resilience of left behind places is still underexplored, especially in the light of entrenched regional disparities. The aim of this paper is to investigate the nexus between regional development and economic resilience across 898 European NUTS 3 regions during the COVID-19 pandemic. To go beyond the GDP-based approach, we construct a multidimensional "left behindness" index. Our findings show that left-behind places, as identified through this multidimensional approach, were relatively more successful in resisting the immediate pandemic shock, while more developed regions demonstrated a stronger recovery capacity. The analysis also highlights that international trade, industrial specialization and the share of public employment acted as determinants of these divergent resilience trajectories. The results suggest that policymakers should adopt a differentiated strategy by strengthening the resistance of more advanced regions and enhancing the recovery capacity of left behind places to reduce persistent regional disparities.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建多维"落后性"指数，研究898个欧洲NUTS 3地区在COVID-19疫情期间区域发展与经济韧性之间的关系，发现落后地区更能抵抗疫情冲击，而发达地区恢复能力更强。
AI.research_question: 欧洲NUTS 3地区的区域发展与经济韧性在COVID-19疫情期间存在怎样的关系？多维"落后性"如何影响地区对疫情冲击的抵抗和恢复能力？
AI.motivation: 当前动荡时期不仅对国家构成挑战，对国内区域更是如此。然而，特别是在根深蒂固的区域差距背景下，落后地区的经济韧性研究仍然不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 区域经济韧性理论、区域发展理论、多维落后性概念框架
AI.method: 构建多维"落后性"指数，分析898个欧洲NUTS 3地区在COVID-19疫情期间的数据，超越传统的GDP方法
AI.findings: 1. 通过多维方法识别的落后地区在抵抗疫情冲击方面相对更成功；2. 更发达地区表现出更强的恢复能力；3. 国际贸易、产业专业化和公共就业比例是这些不同韧性轨迹的决定因素
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出并验证了多维"落后性"指数作为区域韧性分析工具；2. 揭示了区域发展与韧性之间的非线性关系；3. 区分了抵抗能力和恢复能力两种韧性维度
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供差异化策略：加强发达地区的抵抗能力，增强落后地区的恢复能力；2. 有助于减少持续的区域差距；3. 识别了影响区域韧性的关键因素（国际贸易、产业专业化、公共就业）

title: Anatomy (not Autopsy) of the Phillips Curve

detail.title: Anatomy (not Autopsy) of the Phillips Curve

publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
The relationship between inflation and real economic activity has long been central to debates in macroeconomics and monetary policy. At the core of this debate is the Phillips curve (PC), which measures how strongly inflation reacts to movements in economic conditions. The steepness of this curve matters enormously for monetary policy: if the PC is steeper, inflation rises faster during booms and falls faster in recessions, which entails central banks having to act more forcefully if they want to stabilize inflation around their target. Prior analysis found astonishingly small estimates of the slope of the PC, which suggests that the curve is “flat” (or even dead). In this post, I present evidence from coauthored research showing that, contrary to the conventional view, the Phillips curve is alive and steep, and it captures inflation volatility remarkably well once real marginal cost is used instead of standard real economic activity measures.

To view post: https://libertystreeteconomics.newyorkfed.org/2026/02/anatomy-not-autopsy-of-the-phillips-curve/

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了传统观点，证明菲利普斯曲线不仅存在且陡峭，关键在于使用实际边际成本而非传统经济活动指标来衡量通胀反应。
AI.research_question: 菲利普斯曲线是否真的平坦或消失？使用实际边际成本而非传统经济活动指标是否能揭示其真实斜率？
AI.motivation: 通胀与实际经济活动的关系对宏观经济学和货币政策至关重要。先前研究发现菲利普斯曲线斜率极小（平坦甚至消失），这对货币政策制定有重大影响。如果曲线平坦，通胀对经济波动的反应较弱，央行稳定通胀的难度更大。
AI.theoretical_framework: 菲利普斯曲线理论，探讨通胀与经济条件变化之间的关系。重点是比较传统经济活动指标与实际边际成本在衡量通胀反应中的差异。
AI.method: 合作研究，使用实证证据分析菲利普斯曲线斜率。关键方法创新：用实际边际成本替代标准经济活动指标来衡量通胀反应。
AI.findings: 与传统观点相反，菲利普斯曲线不仅存在且陡峭。使用实际边际成本能显著改善对通胀波动的解释能力，揭示出通胀对经济条件变化更强烈的反应。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战菲利普斯曲线"平坦或消失"的主流观点；2. 提出实际边际成本是衡量通胀反应的关键变量；3. 重新确立菲利普斯曲线在宏观经济理论中的核心地位。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 对货币政策制定有重要启示：如果曲线陡峭，央行需要更积极地应对经济波动以稳定通胀；2. 提供更准确的通胀预测工具；3. 改善宏观经济政策决策框架。

detail.abstract: Large sums of dowry (marital transfers from the bride to the groom) customarily paid in Indian weddings make daughters' marriages very expensive. We show that households that have more daughters are more likely to have incurred a debt, reflecting financial strain plausibly induced by the obligation to bear high marriage expenses. This financial strain is mirrored in worse learning outcomes amongst children in households that have a large number of daughters and report being in debt. The results appear to be driven by lower consumption expenditure and greater maternal labor supply in households that incur debts and have firstborn daughters. Consistent with strong son-preference in India, we present suggestive evidence that girls' learning outcomes are more adversely affected than that of boys.

AI.tldr: 印度家庭因女儿结婚需要支付高额嫁妆而面临财务压力，导致更多负债，进而影响子女（特别是女孩）的学习成果
AI.research_question: 印度家庭中女儿数量如何影响家庭负债和子女教育成果？
AI.motivation: 印度婚礼中新娘向新郎支付高额嫁妆的传统使女儿婚姻成本极高，这可能给家庭带来财务压力并影响子女教育
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于印度强烈的重男轻女文化背景，分析嫁妆制度对家庭财务和资源分配的影响
AI.method: 实证分析，通过家庭调查数据检验女儿数量与家庭负债、消费支出、母亲劳动供给及子女学习成果的关系
AI.findings: 1. 女儿越多的家庭越可能负债；2. 负债且女儿多的家庭子女学习成果更差；3. 机制是消费支出降低和母亲劳动供给增加；4. 女孩学习成果受影响比男孩更严重
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了嫁妆制度如何通过家庭财务渠道影响子女教育，特别是性别差异，为理解发展中国家性别偏好与人力资本投资的关系提供新视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供证据，说明嫁妆制度对家庭福利和性别平等的负面影响，支持改革嫁妆习俗和加强女孩教育支持的政策
